raw.description:
Design System Lead

Location: Bristol/London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Team: UX
Contract: Permanent
Reporting To: Head of UX

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

  • Shape the future of the design system and the global Agent Experience product as an equal partner to engineering, product, and delivery

  • Create and deliver the design strategy for the system in direct partnership with the engineering lead, holding joint accountability for its direction

  • Set and uphold the design and UX quality bar across every contribution, including accessibility, comfortable challenging engineers and designers alike, and being challenged in return

  • Run the contribution process end to end, so teams beyond our own can propose, design, and ship into the system, from first proposal through to full adoption

  • Design, prototype, and ship components yourself, including using AI-assisted tools to move from Figma to production code, built to WCAG 2.2 AA from the start

  • Coach and develop the designers and engineers who build with the system, raising the bar for how people use and contribute to it

  • Represent the design system to stakeholders across the business, advocating for its value and shaping how the wider company understands and invests in it

  • Champion good design and accessibility thinking in architecture and technical decisions, working alongside senior engineering leaders as a peer

What you’ll bring
Ideally you’ll have/be

  • Deep experience designing, building, and evolving a design system at scale, tokens, component APIs, documentation, and governance

  • Strong design and UX judgement, starting from the user, with genuine comfort challenging and being challenged by engineers and other designers

  • Practical knowledge of WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards, with real empathy for designing for users with accessibility needs, not just compliance

  • Confidence working in code, using AI-assisted tools to take a component from design intent through to shipped reality

  • Experience running a contribution or change process across multiple teams or apps, from proposal to full migration

  • A track record setting and delivering technical and design strategy jointly with engineering, iteratively, through genuine ambiguity, not from a finished plan

  • Strong communication skills, able to hold your opinions loosely, and to raise what matters even when it’s inconvenient, across engineering, product, and the wider business

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, and developing other designers

  • A bias to action, comfortable building momentum in the face of real uncertainty

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.


Our Values

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do


As the QA Lead across Data you will work closely with the Data Org, setting the testing approach and quality standards for its products and platforms.

You will be the quality partner for data delivery teams, advising on testing and quality assurance across the software delivery lifecycle. You will work with Data Engineering, Product teams, and clients to make sure changes meet the defined quality bar before they reach client environments.

This is an individual contributor role with no line management responsibilities. You will influence through expertise, relationships, and evidence.

  • Define and own the test strategy and test plans for the Data Org, deciding what is tested and how, based on risk, criticality, and impact to the business and clients.

  • Create and deliver test plans for complex data systems, covering functional, transformation, schema, and ETL/migration testing, plus end-to-end coverage across data and engineering teams.

  • Set the quality gates that determine whether a change is fit to be promoted to client environments, and assess release readiness against milestones.

  • Ensure defects are logged, triaged, prioritised, and tracked to resolution in accordance with Quality standards, and drive root-cause analysis on recurring or high-impact issues.

  • Select and maintain the tools and frameworks used for testing, with automated checks running in CI/CD.

  • Work with delivery teams, programme teams, and clients to support queries on test data and releases, and to maintain client confidence through clear, professional communication.

  • Influence engineers, data analysts, and leadership to adopt a test-first mindset and own the quality of their products, and hold a firm line on quality standards.

  • Report on test progress, quality trends, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and raise delivery risks and blockers early.

  • Maintain documentation of quality standards, test coverage, and decisions, with transparency on known issues and risks.

  • Act as the subject matter expert on data testing and data quality practices, including data quality checks (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, validity, timeliness).

What you’ll bring

  • Proven QA and testing experience: Strong knowledge of QA strategies, processes and methodologies, including defining and executing test plans, test cases and test scripts for complex software applications.

  • Agile, test-first delivery: Experience in cross-functional Agile teams with a test-first mindset, managing priorities, scope and risk to maximise testing impact across distributed engineering organisations.

  • Data testing and SQL: Working knowledge of data testing methods (data quality checks, schema validation, transformation testing, ETL/migration testing), plus SQL proficiency for querying and profiling large datasets to diagnose quality issues.

  • Quality metrics and reporting: Experience building quality metrics, dashboards and reporting for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Collaboration and communication: Strong stakeholder management and verbal and written communication skills, working with development, product and client teams at all levels of management, including client engagement.

  • Influence and coaching: Ability to influence and negotiate across engineering, product and leadership, hold a firm line on quality standards, and coach engineers and product managers to own the quality of their products.

  • Client Delivery: experience working directly with client teams to define and report quality metrics, and to introduce quality improvement plans.

  • Nice to have: Test automation framework experience; defining quality gates in CI/CD or release pipelines; AI tools for identifying and fixing data issues; data testing and observability tooling; familiarity with data governance, data contracts and GDPR; and Python and visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker).

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

raw.title: Technical Product Manager
raw.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The role

You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team

  • Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets

  • Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it)

  • Tolerate (maybe even relish) ambiguity, and know when to make decisions quickly vs. when something needs more thought

  • Bridge the link between our customers and our engineering team

  • Help shape the product roadmap and vision for Kernel

What we’re looking for

We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who can own and lead product work from discovery to implementation.

  • Scar tissue: 6+ years of Product Management experience in an early-stage environment, where you’ve learned the hard way what works and what doesn’t, and built complex products and features along the way

  • Evals: Comfortable with evals for agents and driving quality improvements via evals and recursive self-improvement

  • Technical IQ: Comfortable with API, data pipelines, SQL, and so on. A background in product engineering is a strong plus.

  • Extreme ownership: You own your area, cradle-to-grave; this is not a relay race where you only do one part and then hand off the next bit of product work to someone else

  • Clever use of AI: You’re an aggressive and proficient user of AI, but you never switch off the local LLM that you were born with :)

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you

  • Want to work remotely. This role is in our London office at least four days a week; most of the team does five.

  • Don't enjoy the pace and intensity of an early-stage startup

  • Have side projects or want to manage a team immediately

  • Need perfect clarity before starting.

  • Prefer long cycles and big “reveals.”

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £110K - £145K base + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

Interview Process

Stage 1 - Screening Call with Hiring Manager

Stage 2 - Case study (onsite)

Stage 3 - Founders' values interview

We are building a vertically integrated, AI-native property operations and financial services business serving landlords and tenants. Letly runs rental homes end to end; Aravis is building the accounts, payments and finance around those relationships.

Our ambition is to make managing money and financing a home radically easier and cheaper. We’re a small, AI-native team in London, building for global scale.

 

The role

You’ll own the user experience of Aravis, turning complex financial tasks into clear, usable journeys. Working directly with the founders, product owners and engineers, you’ll take problems from research through to tested, shipped experiences.

We’re looking for exceptional UX judgement: understanding how people navigate, interpret information, make decisions and recover when something goes wrong.

 

What you’ll own

  • Customer understanding: speak to landlords and tenants, observe how they complete tasks and identify where they struggle.

  • Journeys and information architecture: organise the product and design coherent flows across onboarding, accounts, payments, cards and lending.

  • Consistent patterns: develop reusable components and interactions that make the product easier to learn and use as it grows.

 

What we’re looking for

  • The ability to simplify an experience while preserving the information customers need to make sound decisions.

raw.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

As the Workplace Technology Lead you'll be the domain expert and technical authority for workplace technology and AV innovation within Corporate Engineering. Setting technical direction, leading technology delivery for capital builds, and creating and owning repeatable standards that support employees, clinicians and members.

This is a senior technical leadership role, so you'll deliver by influencing, coordinating and partnering across the organisation (Engineering, Facilities, Clinical, Real Estate). It combines hands-on delivery, programme leadership and practical AI solutions, and you'll shape how the function grows as Neko expands.

Your scope covers collaboration and meeting spaces, employee experience, executive briefing centres, clinic environmental AV and debrief-room presentation, digital signage, and technology integration across a growing portfolio of health centres. Network, security, facilities, clinical systems and scanning hardware stay with their specialist owners, and you'll work closely with them.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Map the estate, opening pipeline, suppliers, ownership and risks in your first 60 days, and agree the role charter, roadmap and budget baseline with Technology and Operations

  • Create a global technology roadmap aligned to expansion plans, workplace needs and the member experience, turned into investment priorities, delivery plans and lifecycle budgets

  • Act as design authority for workplace and AV: define reference designs, preferred solutions and a clear process for local variations

  • Review existing standards, take full ownership of them in Corporate Engineering, and create a repeatable technology build playbook, piloted on an agreed site or room type

  • Lead the technology workstream for new offices, health centres and refurbishments, from feasibility and design through procurement, commissioning and operational handover

  • Own the integrated technology programme: financial forecasts, risks, changes and executive reporting, with clear readiness criteria, acceptance tests and defect tracking for each opening

  • Work with clinical operations and design teams on debrief displays, ambient audio, signage and controls, prioritising simple use, discretion and a calm environment for members

  • Test two approved operational AI use cases, for example automated commissioning tools, through measured pilots

  • Establish asset and lifecycle records, supplier reviews and service requirements with Procurement and support owners

  • Deliver a costed proposal and an 18–24 month plan for the next stage of the function, with any hiring linked to the site pipeline and support demand

What We're Looking For

  • Substantial experience in workplace technology, enterprise AV and integrated systems, including delivery across multiple countries and physical environments

  • A record of technical leadership: setting standards across a complex portfolio and developing others through influence rather than line authority

  • Experience taking technology projects through architectural design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, with commercial and programme accountability

  • Ability to explain technical decisions to executives, clinicians, designers and delivery partners, and to connect investment choices to practical user needs

  • Practical curiosity about AI and automation, with the judgement to test outputs and involve specialist owners

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare or regulated-environment experience

  • Enterprise and experiential delivery experience

Equal Opportunity and Inclusion

Neko Health is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the hiring process.

raw.description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

AI is changing what it means to deploy enterprise software. Configuring a customer's procurement workflows used to mean weeks of manual setup, integration by integration, edge case by edge case. Increasingly, that first-draft build work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI agents can generate workflow configurations, draft integration mappings, and produce the initial pass on a customer's setup.

The job shifts with it. Instead of building every workflow yourself, you specify exactly what needs to exist, direct AI to build it, and apply the judgment AI can't: is this the right configuration for this customer's approval policy, will Legal and Finance actually sign off on it, does it hold up once real spend starts flowing through it. In practice, that might mean catching that the approval chain AI just drafted works perfectly for HQ, but misses a regional delegation-of-authority rule that would fail an audit in the customer's APAC entity.

As Omnea's AI Solutions Lead, you own deployment of the Omnea platform end to end - typically running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently - for some of Europe's most recognisable companies. You advise customers on the best-fit configuration, direct AI-assisted build work to get there fast, and validate every output against what the customer actually needs. You'll also deal with the politics that come with every enterprise rollout: the Legal team wanting one more sign-off, the Finance stakeholder who doesn't trust the new approval flow, the exec sponsor who's gone quiet. You become the internal voice of the customer, and you're judged on outcomes you can point to: time to launch, post-go-live CSAT, and whether that customer becomes a case study or reference.

This is an early hire on Omnea's customer team, working directly with our sales, customer, product, and engineering leadership. The future shape of the role is yours to define!

What You'll Do

Discover and design

  • Run discovery with customer stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, and IT, and translate their process into an Omnea configuration

  • Design the target workflow: approval chains, routing logic, integrations, and the edge cases that make procurement hard

  • On a deployment with a dozen-plus integrations, you own the sequencing - what has to land first, what blocks what - and the harder calls underneath it: which system is the source of truth for a given entity, and how records reconcile when two systems key that entity differently

  • Define success criteria and a realistic path to go-live with the customer's project sponsor

Build with AI, not instead of it

  • You're not just directing AI to draft your own deliverables faster - you're configuring the specialized agents Omnea's customers rely on every day: an intake agent that knows how to ask a procurement analyst the right follow-up question, a risk agent that flags what actually matters to this customer's Legal team

  • The real leverage comes from chaining agents together - an intake agent that hands clean, structured requests to a risk agent, which in turn routes into approvals with the right context already attached. You design how those agents work as a system, not just individually

  • Writing a spec for one agent is a skill. Writing one that holds up across a chain of agents - where one agent's output becomes another's input - is the actual bar here

  • Validate every AI-generated output against the customer's actual process, policy, and edge cases before anything ships

  • Handle what AI can't: judgment calls on ambiguous requirements, custom logic, and anything that needs a human read on internal politics

Deploy and prove value

  • Present configured workflows to stakeholders, from procurement analysts to CFOs, working through the pushback and internal politics that come with any enterprise rollout, and win their buy-in

  • Run multi-day onsite workshops with customers, coordinating dozens of stakeholders across multiple workstreams at once - a different muscle than a single stakeholder meeting

  • Project-manage the deployment: timelines, blockers, stakeholder alignment, and a clear path to launch, acting as an extension of the customer's team

  • Track adoption after go-live and keep the configuration working as the customer's process evolves

  • Work with Product and Engineering during the design phase, not just after something breaks in the field - you're often the earliest signal on whether a new module will hold up for an enterprise customer, and that shapes what gets built next

What's Different About This Role

  • You'll spend more time specifying and validating than building from scratch. AI produces the first draft; you make sure it's right for this customer

  • Writing instructions AI can act on precisely is a skill you'll build fast here. Vague requests produce vague configurations

  • Judgment matters more, not less. AI speeds up the build, but you decide whether the output is right for this contract, this Board, this customer

  • You'll keep experimenting as our AI tooling evolves, and share what works with the rest of the team

About You

We don't expect you to know how to do all of this on day one. TL;DR: you're ambitious and hard-working, as comfortable directing an AI agent through a tricky configuration as you are presenting a project plan to an exec. You make up for any gap in experience with hunger and a genuine growth mindset. You derive energy from building relationships, shipping projects, and making customers succeed.

  • 4-8 years in a fast-paced, high-bar environment: a startup, scale-up, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself

    • Less experience? Check out our Solutions Associate role

  • Comfortable directing AI tools to produce first-draft work, and confident enough in your own judgment to catch what's wrong. Prior use of tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor is a strong plus. What matters most is your ability to write clear, specific instructions and evaluate what comes back

  • Client-facing experience, or the natural gravitas to be excellent at it. You can point to a time you went well beyond what a client expected

  • A track record of doing something exceptionally well, whether that's work, academia, sport, or anything else you've put your mind to

  • Comfortable reasoning about system architecture - how data models, primary keys, and integration sequencing interact across a dozen enterprise systems. You don't need to write the integration code, but you need to know why it breaks and be able to reason with the people who do, and you'll need to become an Omnea product expert

  • You build real relationships with people at any level, from a junior procurement analyst to a CFO, and know how to handle pushback and stakeholder politics, not just build rapport

  • Comfortable running rooms of stakeholders across a genuinely cross-functional tool - on a single project you'll interface with the CPO, Legal, Finance, AP, InfoSec, and Compliance, plus each of their technical resources, often all with competing priorities on the same decision

  • Comfortable moving between the detail and the big picture: configuring a workflow in the morning, presenting a project plan to an exec in the afternoon

  • Entrepreneurial, have high ownership, and want to be part of building something. We've signed up to the Future Founder Promise

  • An excellent communicator: clear and concise, verbal and written, even when the subject is complicated

  • Highly organised: comfortable running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently, each at a different stage, without dropping any of them

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Additionally, where roles have hard-specified requirements (e.g. [x] days in office, unable to provide visas, etc), if in your application you provide deterministic check-box confirmation that you do not meet the hard-specified requirements, deterministic (not AI or subjective) automatic rejection criteria are in place.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for our first Lead Account Manager to join Omnea’s customer team. You’ll be excited to own expansion quotas and renewal outcomes for our rapidly scaling customer base, to build a function and to have a massively accelerated career trajectory.

You will own the relationship with our customers throughout the entire customer lifecycle, playing a crucial role in managing our largest and most strategic customers. Your key focus will be to ensure customers get meaningful value from Omnea from the earliest stages & beyond, and through your expertise and the building of deep & long-term relationships with our champions, you will drive renewals, expansion and upsell opportunities. You’ll become a trusted advisor & partner to our customers & stakeholders at all levels (from the procurement managers up to the CFOs) and be the voice of the customer internally, working closely with teams across the business (both technical and commercial) to help ensure we are truly operating with customer-centricity at our core.

You’ll be joining us at an incredibly exciting time, just as things are starting to take off! We're a Series A company having raised $25m from Accel, Point Nine, First Round, and 50+ renowned founders and industry experts. We’ve built an incredible & passionate team — every member was a top performer at their previous business - and our CEO, CCO & CFO went on a similar journey with Tessian, going from $0-30m ARR / $8-$500m valuation, and from pre-seed to Series C (Sequoia, Accel, etc.).

We've spent the past 18 months building & deploying our platform to many of the greatest tech companies out there (Lookout, McAfee, Onfido, Typeform, Proofpoint, etc.), all whilst managing to stay lean & operate efficiently.

Now we’re ready to scale. We are looking for our first Account Management Lead to help make Omnea one of Europe’s leading tech businesses: come build with us!

What Can You Expect?

You’ll do whatever it takes to support & champion our customers in their journey with Omnea. There’ll be a constant mix of strategic work (advising customers on company-wide transformation projects, refining our account management playbooks & processes, etc.) and operational work (driving upsell & expansion conversion, managing enterprise onboarding & deployments with your dedicated Solutions & Implementation Lead, etc.). And you’ll consistently be building meaningful relationships with customers, becoming their go-to person for all things Omnea.

  • You’ll focus on delivering long-term customer value in every interaction and build lasting relationships through consistent engagement with our customers - from the end users (Procurement/Finance/Ops ICs) through to the senior management of the companies (CFOs/CIOs/COOs) - resulting in deep trust, strong champions and reference points for all future customers.

  • You’ll be a trusted & strategic advisor to our customers, ensuring they are successful by partnering with key champions & executive sponsors to develop & execute a mutually agreed-upon success plan covering their entire lifecycle. You’ll act as their product expert, from advising on best-in-class configuration of the platform to sharing learnings from or introductions to similar customers.

  • You’ll own the retention and churn outcomes:

    • You’ll proactively drive towards renewal conversations and identity & close opportunities for multi-year contract extensions.

    • You’ll lead efforts to mitigate customer concerns, reduce churn, and enhance overall customer satisfaction and retention, focusing on both proactive and reactive strategies.

  • You’ll own Net Revenue Retention targets, identifying & closing expansion opportunities. You’ll proactively nurture customer accounts, deepening their understanding of product vision, value proposition and features.

  • You’ll identify advocates and expand our customer community to accelerate our GTM motion. You’ll develop and implement proactive initiatives to increase customer adoption and engagement: co-hosting Omnea roundtables with Sales, writing customer newsletters/blog posts/thought leadership etc. with Marketing. You’ll become well-known in this space.

  • You’ll form a pod with a Solutions & Implementation Lead to ensure you are well supported in expanding the accounts. Bring in our Technical Solutions Experts if you need support and the customer wants to go deeper.

  • You’ll partner with teams across the company - Product, Marketing, Sales - to integrate and align our retention & expansion strategies, translating customer insights into actionable feedback and help strategically guide the direction of the product based on the voice of the customer feedback. You’ll leverage these relationships to achieve success for your customers.

As we scale our Customer function, you’ll have an outsized impact on the business, working with our most strategic customers and defining our Customer Account Management & Success playbooks from the earliest stages. The future scope of this role will be defined by the person who takes on the challenge and ultimately, it is hoped that this person will become a future leader at Omnea.

About You

TL;DR: you’re ambitious & hard-working, and you’re as comfortable handling technical product demos as you are communicating to Execs about the success of a project. You make up for any potential lack of experience with hunger and a constant growth mindset. You are someone who will succeed at whatever you put your mind to. You’re intelligent & can work stuff out from first principles. You derive energy from building meaningful relationships, building a community & network around you, and being a true advocate and champion of our customers.

  • You have 5-7 years of experience succeeding in a B2B SaaS commercial role (i.e. you know you can sell! And can manage the longer-term success of customer accounts). You will have consistently performed at the top of your team‍ and are well-known/have a demonstrable history of having the happiest and most successful customers.

  • You’re entrepreneurial and want to be part of building a business. You want to rise faster or earn more than would be possible in any ‘normal’ career and you’re happy to roll up your sleeves and do whatever’s required. FYI, we've signed up to the Future Founder Promise.

  • You’ve got a track record of exceptional performance, whether it’s in academia, work, sport, a sales team, or whatever else you’ve put your mind to.

  • You have strong commercial intuition and have the gravitas to sell to senior leadership (eg. CFOs, CIOs). You can proactively recognise expansion opportunities and mitigate issues that could affect revenue retention.

  • You’re an outstanding communicator; verbal, written, and when presenting. You’re exceptionally articulate, concise and clear in all forms of communication and have the ability to build rapport, influence people & drive change, whether it’s with a distinguished exec, technical expert or a junior operator. You build ultimate trust with customer stakeholders.

  • You’re intelligent and have the capacity to rapidly understand our product inside and out, without the crutch of relying on sales engineers. You can simplify complex problems and translate them into next steps, product configuration or new feature requests.

  • You’re outcomes-focused, and balance the ability to think strategically with a heavy bias to action, always focused on “so what’s the next step?”.

  • You are proactive & crave accountability, proactively pushing initiatives forward and making the best use of the resources available to you.

  • You’re able to ruthlessly prioritise, are highly organised and focused on outputs > inputs. You are efficient & autonomous and don’t compromise on quality.

  • You’re ambitious, competitive, and care lots about your career. You are probably happiest when working really hard and solving challenging problems/winning deals. You know this requires dedication & some sacrifice but you think it’s worth it.

  • You’re just a really good human. You’re empathetic and reliable. You build trust with people you work with and are highly collaborative. You have minimal ego, seek feedback to continuously hone your craft and try to bring out the best in everyone around you.

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Jump:

The Jump is Omnea's 12-month programme for ambitious engineers who want to make the jump to senior, faster than they could elsewhere. You'll join one of our product teams as a Product Engineer and take on progressively bigger, harder work, with the support to grow into it.

Plenty of companies promise fast progression. We back it with structure:

  • Real scope. Ship from week one, own a feature end to end in your first quarter, and lead a project with one or two other engineers by months 6–9.

  • A buddy for the year. An experienced engineer from another team, not your manager, who meets you every month for the full 12 months and talks you through how they make decisions.

  • Six practical sessions in your first six months. Live, in-person sessions across two Jump Day afternoons, covering impact, autonomy, product and design, customers, commercial and influence. Each is built around a real Omnea project and applied straight to your own work. No bootcamp.

  • Honest feedback. A monthly self-review talked through with your buddy, and a quarterly progression review with your team lead, so you always know where you stand.

  • Promotion when you're ready. As soon as you're consistently operating at the next level, judged against the same bar as everyone else. Not held for an annual review.


What Success Looks Like:

We expect you to be operating at the next level within about 12 months. We'll give you the scope, the buddy and the feedback, so you can drive your progression as fast and as far as you can. We'll track your progress together through structured checkpoints across the year, so you always know where you stand.

Our bar is high. Our levels mean more here than at most companies, and promotion is judged on how you operate, not on finishing a programme.


What We're Looking For:

We're looking for product-minded engineers with real drive to join our engineering team. We're a tight-knit group of ambitious builders who hold the bar high. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~220 to 400+, and revenue will triple. In this role, you'll build high-quality product features and systems using the latest in AI, both as a developer tool and embedded directly into our product, owning meaningful problem spaces end-to-end and having a direct impact on customers as we scale.


What Can You Expect On Our Engineering Team?

  • Join a Skilled Team. Become part of one of Europe's fastest-growing software companies, working alongside experienced full-stack product engineers from top technology businesses and startups.

  • Direct Product Impact. Help shape key product decisions, including roadmap prioritisation, project scoping, technical direction, user experience, and implementation strategy.

  • Work with Modern Technology. Our stack is TypeScript across the stack (frontend and backend), React, Postgres, and AWS serverless infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, and EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. We use Datadog for observability, Meticulous for automated visual regression testing, and Incident.io for incident management.

  • AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude Code and agentic workflows every day to write, review, and ship code faster, and our product is itself built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows.

  • End-to-End Ownership. Own projects from initial idea through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. You'll work across the stack and be trusted to make decisions that drive meaningful outcomes.

  • Continuous Delivery. We deploy small, incremental changes to production multiple times per day, enabling rapid iteration and fast customer feedback loops.

  • Tackle Scalability Challenges. As we grow, you'll help scale our systems, architecture, and engineering practices while maintaining performance, reliability, and developer velocity.

  • Collaboration and Autonomy. We operate as a high-trust team where individuals are expected to take ownership while collaborating closely to solve difficult problems.

  • Customers at the Center. We regularly engage directly with customers to understand their problems, gather feedback, and ensure we're building products that create genuine value.


About You:

  • You're a strong engineer on a fast trajectory. Around 3–5 years of professional software engineering in a well-respected engineering environment, shipping features end to end, full-stack in TypeScript (AWS serverless is a plus). If your trajectory is exceptional, we'll look past the years.

  • You're proactive. You spot problems and fix them, or get them to the right person, without being asked. You keep people updated rather than waiting to be chased.

  • You're ready for more scope. You've owned well-defined work and want the next step: vague briefs, bigger projects and more people to work with.

  • You're coachable. You ask for feedback, act on it and learn fast from mistakes.

  • You're driven and ambitious. You want to progress quickly, own your growth and push for harder problems. If there's a chance to take on something bigger, you take it.

  • You've got grit. You work hard and keep going when things get difficult.

  • You're curious about the product and the customer. You want to know why something is being built, not just how.

  • You lift others. You help teammates, share what you know and make the team better.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • You've performed exceptionally at something else, be it academics, sport, or work. You've gone above and beyond the norm.

  • You've grown fast before. Your scope or responsibilities grew quickly in a previous role.

  • You love engineering. It's more than a job. You've contributed to open source or worked on side projects just because you enjoy it. You're confident tackling ambiguous problems and shipping quality code.


Interview Process:

Before applying, we strongly encourage you to spend a few minutes in our R&D Candidate Hub. It covers our engineering culture, ways of working, interview process, tech environment, and what it's like to build at Omnea.

>> R&D Candidate Hub: R&D Candidate Hub

The process varies slightly by level but generally includes:

  1. Initial screening call with the Talent team (30 mins - remote)

  2. AI Product Eng Challenge - language agnostic (1 hour - remote)

  3. Onsite interviews: Engineering culture interview, System design and Engineering leadership interviews (3 hours - in-person)

For The Jump, we look for trajectory as much as experience: how fast you've learned and how quickly your scope has grown.

We're proud to support visa sponsorship for candidates who need it.

raw.title: Account Director, Startups | New Business - UK&I
raw.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Account Director to join our Startups UKI Go To Market team. You will play a critical role in owning relationships with top startup customers and supporting them in building successfully on the OpenAI platform.

We believe that many of the most disruptive and category-defining AI applications will be created by startups. The Startup Go To Market team’s mission is to help startups harness the power of AI models to drive these advances. You will support startups building effectively with OpenAI’s APIs, and provide access to OpenAI teams and expertise to support their growth.

This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and strategy. You’ll be responsible for serving as the primary relationship owner for a set of strategically important startup customers, as well as working across the OpenAI organization to help these startups accelerate their progress and be successful using our models. You’ll work cross-functionality with product, research, engineering, support, and solutions architecture to help customers get the most out of our models.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage a portfolio of startups accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan.

  • Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects.

  • Own a consumption revenue target.

  • Manage consumption revenue forecasts.

  • Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.

  • Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering.

  • Serve as an advocate for improving the startup experience building with OpenAI, synthesizing product feedback from insights captured from our work with startups.

  • Closely monitor the industry landscape and startup landscape to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.

  • Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates.

  • Support the development of company culture.

We're seeking someone with experience in:

  • 6+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service.

  • Designing and executing complex deal strategies.

  • Experience working in or around the startup ecosystem, preferably as either a founder of a startup, an employee of a startup, or someone who worked with startup customers.

  • Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies.

  • Working directly with C-level executives.

  • Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.).

  • Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.

  • Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.

  • Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.

  • Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.

  • Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Community team focuses on finding exceptional power users of our tools and turning real usage into stories and signals that shape both product direction and how the world understands OpenAI. We do that by learning directly from users, then working together to package insights and use cases into formats that can travel: playbooks, webpages, launch assets, event series, and clear guidance on how people actually use our tools.

About the Role

The Head of Community, EMEA,will lead OpenAI’s community presence across the region and be responsible for setting and evolving an evidence-based Community strategy in markets, including hiring local community leads and managers .

The role is responsible for how we create trusted relationships with power users and translate those relationships into participation, insight, enablement, and stories across the region. They will partner with senior leadership to recommend where Community can have the greatest impact across EMEA, laddering up to company and country level priorities.

Immediately, they will oversee our Student Collective motion in EMEA markets, including working with our global team, global agency and hiring Student Community Managers and coordinators in markets. They will also shape how we roll out additional community work with SMBs and Pro subscribers in close collaboration with the global program leads.

We’re looking for an experienced community leader who has held senior roles at multiple companies, including those where community is central to how people learn, build, create, or share their work.

They understand how to combine thoughtful relationships with programs that can reach many more people. They are comfortable building the first relationships themselves, identifying what makes them valuable, and developing a team that can sustain that quality as the work grows.

They bring strong judgement about which communities and fandoms to invest in, how global programs should adapt to local needs, and how community learning can inform decisions across OpenAI.

In this role, you will:

Build the broader EMEA Community strategy:

  • Map the EMEA community landscape and develop a point of view on which user communities OpenAI should know, support and learn from.

  • Build high-trust direct relationships with power users across relevant segments, and help scale that relationship building motion across EMEA where strategically justified.

  • Define a clear expansion logic: which communities and fandoms to explore, why they matter, what Community can uniquely contribute and what resourcing they require.

  • Develop country and regional priorities together with country leads, combining local community insights, market context, and company goals.

  • Create repeatable playbooks for launching, learning from and scaling community programs across EMEA without losing local relevance.

Lead regional community programs:

  • Partner with country leads and local Community teams to develop market priorities and programs, drawing on local user insights and cultural context while maintaining accountability for regional outcomes.

  • Work with global program leads and country leads to adapt global programs, develop initiatives originating in markets, and share successful approaches across EMEA, with clear expectations for member experience, participation, and learning.

  • Oversee the Student Collective across EMEA, working with the agency partner and hiring and supporting local Student Community Managers and Coordinators in markets.

  • Shape and deliver SMB and Pro subscriber programs with global and country leads, including targeted engagement with knowledge worker communities and fandoms where there is a clear opportunity.

Turn relationships into participation, insights, and stories:

  • Source and curate compelling use cases and stories, spotlight community members, and equip them to share their knowledge with wider audiences, helping more people discover practical ways to use AI

  • Synthesise patterns by market, community, segment and use case; distinguish isolated anecdotes from signals worth acting on.

  • Publish regular updates and recaps that highlight progress, insights, risks and opportunities and clear recommendations.

  • Work cross-functionally to route relevant learnings into product, research, brand and product marketing, education, communications,and global affair teams so that these stories and insights can benefit millions more around the world.

Operate and scale the function:

  • Hire, support, and develop regional and market teams needed to grow EMEA Community work, maintaining the quality of user relationships as programs scale.

  • Work with our global team to build the systems, dashboards, cadences, xfn partners, templates and decision making processes needed to run EMEA Community work well.

  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment, clear ownership and follow-through.

  • Represent OpenAI credibly with community members, campus partners and regional ecosystem stakeholders.

  • Strong regional and market community team delivering effective community programs, including the Student Collective and emerging SMB and Pro subscriber initiatives. Clear recommendations on which communities and programs to scale, adapt, pause, or invest in, developed with country leads.

  • High-trust user relationships that lead to robust participation, useful insights, and breakthrough stories, helping OpenAI improve product, marketing, education, and communications decisions while growing advocates in the region.

  • Have 10+ years of experience building, leading or scaling communities, user programmes or ecosystem initiatives across EMEA.

raw.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, support responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Operations, and partner organisations to turn strategic partnerships into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

Cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, and technology partners play a critical role in helping customers adopt and scale OpenAI’s products. Our Partner Sales & Development team connects these partnerships to the field through joint account planning, opportunity development, coordinated sales execution, and delivery alignment that helps customers move from initial interest to production adoption.

About the Role

We are hiring a Partner Sales & Development Manager to lead our partner sales and development team for Southern EMEA. Reporting to the Head of GTM Partnerships, Europe you will manage and develop a regional team, own the regional partner business, and work alongside OpenAI Sales leadership and strategic partners to generate pipeline, advance complex pursuits, and drive revenue and customer adoption.

This is a people management role that combines team leadership, partner business development, co-sell execution, and operational discipline. You will translate broader partnership priorities into a focused regional plan, set team goals and account coverage, and coach your team to engage the right partners at the right point in the customer journey. You will build relationships with partner field leaders and remain hands-on in priority pursuits, working with technical and delivery teams to turn commercial commitments into sustained customer value.

You will be accountable for both regional business performance and the success of your team. We are looking for an experienced people manager who can hire and develop talent, establish clear expectations, manage performance, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the partner sales and development plan for your assigned region, Southern Europe, aligning team coverage, target accounts, partner priorities, sales plays, and execution milestones with regional Sales leadership

  • Drive regional commercial outcomes across partner-sourced and partner-attached pipeline, bookings, production adoption, and expansion, with clear accountability for business performance.

  • Identify and develop new partner-led opportunities. Evaluate where partners can create differentiated customer value, establish executive sponsorship, and build a path from initial engagement to joint execution.

  • Lead account mapping and joint account planning with OpenAI sellers and partner teams to identify whitespace, qualify opportunities, and prioritize the accounts and use cases with the greatest potential.

  • Orchestrate complex co-sell pursuits, aligning account teams, partner sellers, technical stakeholders, and services organizations around customer needs, clear responsibilities, and mutual action plans.

  • Build trusted relationships with regional partner executives and field leaders, while coordinating with global partner owners to ensure regional execution supports the broader partnership strategy.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and partner delivery teams to address technical and implementation dependencies and help customers deploy, adopt, and expand AI workloads in production.

  • Create repeatable field engagement models, partner enablement, sales plays, and escalation paths that make it easier for OpenAI and partner teams to work together effectively.

  • Establish disciplined pipeline reviews, forecasting, business reviews, and performance reporting. Use evidence to assess partner contribution, diagnose underperformance, and adjust investments and priorities.

  • Navigate complex stakeholder relationships, commercial tradeoffs, and competing priorities with sound judgment, working across Legal, Security, Finance, and other teams as needed.

  • Hire, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing regional partner sales and development team. Set individual and team goals, provide regular feedback, manage performance, and support career growth.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience in enterprise sales, partner sales, strategic alliances, or business development within cloud, AI, SaaS, or enterprise technology.

  • A track record of owning regional or segment-level business outcomes and delivering measurable pipeline, revenue, and customer growth through partners.

  • Demonstrated direct people management experience in partner sales, enterprise sales, alliances, or a related GTM function, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and team development.

  • Deep familiarity with cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, or technology partner ecosystems, and an understanding of how their field organizations sell and deliver.

  • Experience creating opportunities and leading complex partnerships or customer engagements from discovery and qualification through commercial execution, launch, adoption, and expansion.

  • Strong enterprise sales fundamentals, including account planning, opportunity qualification, stakeholder mapping, negotiation, pipeline management, and forecasting.

  • The ability to earn trust with Sales leaders, partner executives, technical teams, and peers, and to resolve disagreements constructively in a matrixed organization.

  • Technical-commercial fluency: you can understand customer use cases, translate partner needs into clear requirements, and engage product and technical teams on implementation tradeoffs.

  • Strong operational judgment and a builder mindset. You can create structure where a playbook does not yet exist, adapt as priorities change, and move quickly without sacrificing customer trust.

  • Clear communication, executive presence, self-awareness, and a collaborative approach to feedback and problem-solving.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams and aligning account or territory coverage across a region.

  • Experience building or scaling a regional partner sales or co-sell business at a high-growth technology company.

  • Experience aligning sales and partner delivery organisations to support enterprise implementations and sustained production adoption.

  • Familiarity with AI platforms, modern cloud architectures, cloud marketplaces, and enterprise procurement models.

Patsnap is seeking a commercially minded, technically capable leader to manage and develop our global Solutions Consulting team, supporting all products supporting Patsnap's portfolio across Intellectual Property, Life Sciences, Materials Science and Engineering.

As we expand our AI capabilities, our approach to Solutions Consulting is evolving. Beyond traditional product demonstrations and technical evaluations, we're increasingly helping customers integrate Patsnap's intelligence, AI agents and data directly into their existing systems and business workflows.

This includes defining how the team approaches technical discovery, solution development and customer engagement, ensuring we're equipped to support increasingly complex enterprise requirements.

This role offers the opportunity to have a genuine impact on how we operate, how we support our customers and how we bring our next generation of AI capabilities to market.

We're looking for someone who brings substantial experience leading customer-facing technical teams, alongside the technical depth to challenge, guide and contribute to solution development. You'll be responsible for building a function that not only supports commercial growth, but plays an increasingly important role in how customers adopt and integrate Patsnap's technology into their operations.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

This is a hybrid position based in our Farringdon office, with a requirement to work on-site at least one day per week, on Wednesdays.

 

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO technology company transforming how organisations use Intellectual Property and Research & Development intelligence to drive innovation.

Our AI-powered platform connects patent intelligence, scientific research, Life Sciences data and market insights, helping organisations make more informed decisions, accelerate R&D and bring new innovations to market.

Trusted by over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the world's leading innovators, we've raised $300 million in Series E funding, reaching a valuation of over $1 billion.

As we continue to evolve into an AI-native business, we're enabling customers to integrate our proprietary data, AI agents and intelligence directly into their existing technology and business processes.

With offices in Singapore, London, Toronto and Shanghai, alongside remote teams across the US, we're an international business with ambitious plans for continued growth. Our culture is high-performing but low ego, with a strong emphasis on collaboration, ownership and developing people.

What You'll Be Doing:

Global Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach and develop the global Solutions Consulting team, setting clear expectations for performance, customer impact and commercial contribution.

  • Recruit and integrate FDEs, combining consulting expertise, domain knowledge and practical technical delivery within one team.

  • Assess capability gaps and implement development plans covering AI workflows, MCPs, APIs, data handling, prototyping and solution design.

  • Establish practical standards for technical proficiency and ensure learning translates into demonstrated customer-facing capability.

  • Prioritise team resources across regions, verticals and commercial opportunities.

  • Build a culture of accountability, experimentation, collaboration and knowledge sharing.

Customer Engagement & Commercial Partnership

  • Partner closely with Sales, Account Management and Customer Success to support new business, expansion and customer adoption.

  • Lead discovery sessions that uncover customer priorities, workflows, technical requirements and desired business outcomes.

  • Oversee and participate in demonstrations, workshops, technical evaluations and enterprise solution discussions.

  • Translate complex product and data capabilities into clear customer value and compelling commercial propositions.

  • Establish clear scope, success criteria and timelines for proofs of concept (PoCs), aligning technical work with qualified commercial opportunities.

  • Build trusted relationships with business leaders, domain practitioners and technical stakeholders.

AI, MCP & Data Solution Delivery

  • Lead by example in configuring and demonstrating practical solutions using Patsnap’s products, AI agents, MCPs, APIs and data.

  • Help customers incorporate Patsnap capabilities into their own AI environments and business processes.

  • Guide Solutions Consultants and FDEs in building rapid prototypes, testing workflows and validating customer value.

  • Ensure evaluations consider output quality, source traceability, data permissions, integration requirements and usage costs.

  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering to progress successful prototypes into supported solutions, with Engineering owning production architecture, security and platform development.

Product Collaboration & Scalable Solutions

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering and subject matter experts to translate customer needs into product improvements and repeatable solutions.

  • Create a clear process for sharing field feedback and progressing promising customer prototypes into product development.

  • Turn successful engagements into reusable Skills, connectors, workflow templates, demonstrations and implementation guidance.

  • Ensure the team can support the full portfolio, drawing on domain specialists where deeper expertise is required.

  • Contribute to commercial enablement through use cases, discovery frameworks, demo narratives and evidence of customer outcomes.

  • Identify recurring customer needs that create opportunities for differentiated data offerings, integrations and AI workflows.


What We'd Love From You:

We're looking for an experienced Solutions Consulting or Sales Engineering leader who has successfully developed customer-facing technical teams and understands how to build a function that contributes directly to enterprise commercial success. you'll bring the technical depth to engage meaningfully in solution design and AI development, alongside the leadership experience to build capability at scale.

Required Experience

  • Proven leadership experience: 5+ years leading Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering or comparable customer-facing technical teams within enterprise SaaS, data or AI.

  • Commercial impact: Proven experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles, influencing technical buying decisions and connecting technical solutions to measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Technical credibility: Practical experience with APIs, data integrations, AI tools and workflow automation, with the ability to build, adapt or critically assess technical prototypes and demonstrations.

  • AI and agentic workflows: A working understanding of AI agents, MCP and how LLM-powered applications connect with external systems, tools and data.

  • Team development: Experience recruiting, coaching and developing technical talent, including improving the technical capabilities of an established team.

  • Enterprise customer engagement: Strong discovery, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to engage senior business leaders and technical decision-makers.

  • Global and cross-functional leadership: Experience working across international teams and partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Product and Engineering.

  • Strategic and commercial judgement: The ability to assess opportunity value, prioritise resources and balance technical delivery with wider commercial objectives.

Even Better If You Have:

  • Experience introducing Forward Deployed Engineering capabilities or evolving a traditional pre-sales function towards more advanced technical solution delivery.

  • Exposure to Intellectual Property, Life Sciences, R&D, Materials Science or innovation intelligence.

  • Experience using Python, JavaScript or low-code tools for prototyping, data manipulation and workflow automation.

  • Knowledge of enterprise AI adoption, including retrieval, AI agent evaluation and data governance.

  • Experience turning customer-specific technical solutions into reusable assets, integrations or scalable product capabilities.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, collaborative, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Two paid volunteering days

  • Private healthcare with AXA

  • Pension with Scottish Widows

  • Enhanced parental leave policies

  • Work from home stipend

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Payroll giving options

  • Eyecare vouchers
