raw.title: Revenue Operations Manager  - London
raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Perk is going through a period of significant growth, and we're using AI and automation to make our sales teams more productive and to take manual work out of our reps' day-to-day, in our tools and in the CRM. Nowhere is that more visible than in our SDR organisation, where we are rolling out AI-driven outbound prospecting with tools like Clay.

We're hiring a Revenue Operations Manager in Barcelona to support our SDR organisation globally. This is a senior individual contributor role: a strategic business partner to SDR leadership on process, systems, and operating cadences, and the business owner of the SDR tech stack, from Sales Engagement tooling to LinkedIn Sales Navigator and enrichment. You'll own how SDRs prospect, engage, and hand off pipeline, from the data and signals that tell them who to contact, to the sequences and automations that help them do it at scale, to the reporting that shows what is working.

We're looking for a true owner who understands what good looks like, has rolled out AI and automation for outbound at scale elsewhere, and is curious about where AI can take outbound next.

What You'll Do:

Be the strategic partner to SDR leadership

  • Partner with global SDR leaders to define and run the operating model: processes, territories and handoffs, and the weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences that keep the team on track.

  • Work with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Finance to keep lead management and pipeline definitions aligned end to end.

Own the SDR process

  • Own the end-to-end SDR process, from prospecting and outreach to qualification and handoff to Account Executives, and keep it documented in clear playbooks that are consistent across regions.

  • Own the prospecting process: ICP and account prioritisation, signal-based targeting, and outbound cadences.

  • Own the qualification methodology: lead and opportunity definitions, qualification criteria, stage and disqualification logic, and acceptance standards for handoffs, and evolve them as our go-to-market changes.

  • Own the inbound lead process: capture, routing, speed-to-lead standards, follow-up expectations, ownership rules, and the handoff between Marketing and SDRs.

  • Roll out process changes with SDR leaders and Enablement, and make sure they are adopted and followed.

  • Own the Rules of Engagement for outbound and inbound, including account ownership between regional and global accounts, so SDRs, Account Executives, and Marketing know who works which accounts and leads, and conflicts are resolved quickly and fairly.

Own the SDR tech stack

  • Act as the business owner of every tool our SDR organisation uses in its prospecting efforts globally, including Sales Engagement platforms, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and data enrichment tools, owning the roadmap, configuration, licences and cost, adoption, data quality, and vendor relationships.

  • Make sure the tools, the CRM, and the data around them work as one system, so reps spend their time selling, not updating records.

  • Evaluate, pilot, and roll out new tools and features, with clear business cases and success metrics.

  • Partner closely with the Revenue Systems team, who are the technical owners of these tools and manage configuration, syncs, and integrations, by setting priorities and requirements as the business owner, and with Enablement on training and change management.

Drive AI and automation for outbound and inbound

  • Partner with the GTM Engineering team, who own Clay and the AI automation for SDRs, and act as the business owner of the SDR automation roadmap, defining the use cases and priorities for AI-driven outbound: signal-based targeting, account and contact research, enrichment, personalisation, and sequencing.

  • Reduce manual work for SDRs by automating CRM updates, lead and account research, routing, and follow-up, and measure the time saved and the pipeline impact.

  • Design and refine lead routing, scoring, and inbound handling so the right leads reach the right reps quickly.

  • Test and pilot emerging AI capabilities for SDR and inbound use cases, and scale what works with clear guardrails on data quality, compliance, and brand.

Protect data and quality

  • Set the standards for data hygiene, outreach governance, and deliverability across SDR tools, and make sure they are followed.

  • Build the dashboards and reporting that give SDR leaders and reps a single source of truth on activity, funnel, and outcomes.

  • Document processes and playbooks so they are repeatable across regions.

What We're Looking For:

  • Significant experience (typically 5+ years) in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or SDR/Pipeline Operations in B2B SaaS, with a focus on SDR or outbound productivity.

  • Proven experience supporting the roll out of AI and automation for outbound prospecting from a process point of view

  • Deep hands-on knowledge of Salesforce and of Sales Engagement platforms (such as Outreach, Salesloft, or Gong), including sequencing, enrichment, routing, and scoring.

  • Strong analytical skills: you can find the story in funnel and rep-activity data and turn it into decisions that SDR leaders act on.

  • A true owner: you take responsibility for a tool, a process, or an outcome end to end, and you don't wait to be asked.

  • Credibility as a strategic partner to senior sales leaders, comfortable challenging and influencing across Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Finance, and Systems.

  • Strong project and change management skills, with a track record of driving adoption across global teams.

  • Curiosity about AI and where it can take SDR, outbound, and inbound operations next.

  • Comfortable in a fast-growing, fast-changing environment where processes are still being built.

What we offer:

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Hiring Process

  • 30 min online call with Talent Acquisition

  • Online 45min call with the hiring manager

  • IRL Assessment with the Hiring manager + another senior person from the Rev Ops team

  • 30 min online panel interview with the SDR Manager

  • 30 min Online Culture interview with SE Manager

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

AML & KYC Solutions Manager - EMEA
raw.description:
What we're all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We’re heading in one direction: the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

We’re looking for a motivated, self-starting and creative professional to join our Financial Crime team as a Solutions Manager for Quantexa’s Financial Services and Government solutions in EMEA.

You’ll help grow and develop our Financial Crime propositions, working across Go-To-Market, Delivery, Research and Development, and the wider Platform Product Marketing team.

The role combines close collaboration with internal stakeholders with substantial, in-depth engagement with clients and prospects.

What you'll be doing.

  • Shape FinCrime Strategy & Solutions: Leverage your deep domain knowledge to guide the development and overall strategy for Quantexa’s AML and broader financial crime solutions, ensuring they remain highly relevant and well-articulated across multiple lines of business, products, and global markets.

  • Drive Product Roadmap Collaboration: Work closely with cross-departmental teams to help define and prioritize specific product roadmap features that directly enhance the core solution.

  • Champion Thought Leadership & Demos: Build and deliver compelling product demonstrations to senior stakeholders and at industry events; author high-impact thought leadership content, including blogs, whitepapers, and webinars.

  • Support Commercial & Sales Enablement: Partner with commercial teams from initial sales through to customer value realization, leading client workshops to demonstrate solution value and building robust SME knowledge across the business.

  • Develop Collateral with Marketing: Collaborate with marketing teams to create enablement materials, artifacts, and key collateral highlighting Quantexa's unique solution capabilities and market differentiators.

  • Cultivate Stakeholder Relationships: Build, maintain, and deepen key relationships with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

  • Engage Globally: Travel internationally as needed to support and collaborate with our global network of customers and partners.

What you’ll bring.

  • Financial Crime Prevention Expertise: Extensive experience in financial crime prevention within an AML-related domain, preferably with experience in Retail and Corporate Banking AML/CFT and PSP/MSBs (transaction monitoring technology, alert management, investigations across multiple lines of business, etc.). Ideally, the candidate will have prior experience working with Quantexa FinCrime technologies in the stated domains.

  • Demonstrable, extensive experience in deploying, managing, and running Retail Banking AML Transaction Monitoring systems.

  • A proven track record of leading complex system deployments and managing day-to-day operations.

  • Product and solution leadership: A proven track record of leading and executing product strategy, owning solutions and/or developing software, either in-house at a large financial services institution or within an enterprise software vendor. A deep understanding of how AI is shaping financial crime solutions is essential.

  • Executive engagement: Strong executive presence and a proven ability to influence, engage and build trust with C-suite stakeholders at major global banks, insurers and government agencies.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Experience working in a fast-paced, matrixed software product environment, collaborating across sales, alliances, marketing, and Research and Development.

  • Technical understanding: Deep curiosity about, and technical comprehension of, data-driven analytical solutions, including Entity Resolution, Graph/Network Analytics, AI/ML models and Big Data platforms.

  • International travel: Willingness to travel to support strategic customer engagements and partner enablement.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

raw.title: AI Transformation Director
raw.description:
About Riplo

Riplo is a VC-backed, AI-native advisory and technology firm serving private equity across the deal lifecycle. We combine deep diligence expertise, forward-deployed AI teams and our own AI platform to give PE funds and their portfolio companies sharper answers and working AI, faster. We are growing quickly, winning work with leading funds and expanding the team, and this hire is a key part of that next phase.

  • Advisory: thematic research, commercial due diligence (CDD), AI due diligence, AI value creation, AI build solutions and exit readiness.

  • Solutions: forward-deployed AI teams that turn AI value creation plans into working software and measured value inside portfolio companies.

  • Software: building the operating layer for consulting.

  • Clients: mid-market and large-cap PE funds and their portfolio companies across the UK, Europe and the US.

  • Operating model: flat and AI-leveraged. Senior people work directly on the programme, supported by AI rather than layers of juniors.

  • Team: a blend of DD consultants, PE portfolio operators, AI advisors and AI engineers, with advisory and engineering working side by side.

Our team and culture

AI is rewriting the rules of consulting and of how portfolio companies operate. Most advisory firms are waiting to see what happens. We decided to be the ones making it happen.

We are a small, senior team that moves fast, sets a high bar and genuinely enjoys building Riplo together. Every person here shapes what Riplo becomes.

We build side by side in the office 4–5 days a week, because the best ideas come from being in the room together. If you want to sit at the table with us, roll up your sleeves and build something that matters, we want to meet you.

AI Transformation Director, Solutions · London (in office 4–5 days a week) · Full-time

This is not a typical transformation role. You will be a key hire working side by side with our Founding Head of Solutions, leading embedded AI transformation programmes inside PE-backed portfolio companies, standing up and running their AI Transformation Office, and helping build Riplo's Solutions practice from the ground up.

You will own the programme from week 1: governance, roadmap, use-case selection and the path from first build to measured value. Lead AI transformation programmes

raw.title: Founding Engineer (Product)
raw.description:
Founding Product Engineer
London · £120K–£200K plus equity · Visa sponsorship available

The Mission

We are replacing the Management Consulting industry with software.

The $1 trillion consulting industry is powered by some of the world’s brightest minds, yet they remain trapped in manual, inefficient workflows: spreadsheet orchestration, slide-deck assembly, and fragmented data synthesis.

We proved it on ourselves first. Our advisory business serves six private equity funds across the UK, Europe and the US, and one Riplo consultant delivers an engagement that a tier-one firm staffs with a full team. The platform we built behind that work is now open to the world. Next, we are running the same playbook on a much bigger market: AI transformations for PE funds and the companies they own.

Our team comes from QuantumBlack/McKinsey, BCG, DeepMind, Hg Capital and KKR. Cherry Ventures, Blue Lion and the founders of QuantumBlack back us, with angels from OpenAI, McKinsey, BCG and Apple. We are nine people, and we are hiring one Founding Product Engineer.

The Challenge

As our Founding Product Engineer, your role is not just “writing code”. You will report directly to our CTO, and define the product DNA of the company. You will:

  • Build Beyond the Chatbot: Design multi-step agentic workflows that move past simple RAG and produce analysis a PE fund pays for.

  • Make Quality Measurable: “Good enough for a partner” is a hard standard to code against. Build the evals, harnesses and review checks that prove an agent’s output meets it.

  • Turn Evidence into Insight: Connect research, data and sources to the final page, so that every claim on a slide traces back to its evidence.

  • Work Directly with Our Clients: Build AI use cases inside client organisations, alongside the people who use them. What you learn there shapes the core roadmap.

  • Pioneer the Agentic SDLC: Agents write most of our code. Design the systems, steer the agents, and push our own way of building software forward with a very large token budget.

You Are a Fit If:

  • You are a Product Builder: You might be a product engineer at a SaaS company, a product manager who now ships code, or a consultant building serious AI tooling on the side. We judge purely on the quality of what you have built. You don’t need a 20-page PRD. You can take a vague user pain point from a client and ship a functional prototype by Friday.

  • You value Speed: You believe that in an early-stage startup, iteration velocity is the only unfair advantage. You prefer shipping a 90% solution today over a perfect one next month.

  • You are “T-Shaped”: You hold deep experience in one area (product management, management consulting, or front-end engineering), but are comfortable enough with the others to add value across the business.

Our Stack

  • Product: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Tailwind

  • Data and Infra: PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Terraform

  • Real-time: Collaboration over WebSockets

Why Join Us?

  • Real Ownership: £120K to £200K base salary plus equity. You will own a piece of the company you are building, and you will own the product roadmap with the CTO.

  • High Trust / Low Bureaucracy: We value clarity of thought and bias to action. No middle management, no pointless meetings, just building.

  • The Practicalities: London-based, four days a week in the office, one flexible day, and client site time when projects require it. Visa sponsorship available.

Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide across tech, retail/commerce, entertainment/media, gaming, consumer packaged goods and finance.

Role Summary:

As a Customer Support Specialist, you’ll be on the front lines of customer interaction, playing a vital role in delivering exceptional service and resolving inquiries efficiently and empathetically. In this role, you will gain hands-on experience within the fast paced, ever evolving mobile app ecosystem and have the opportunity to engage directly with executives and team members from high growth companies. You’ll also collaborate across departments, working closely with product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and to provide feedback that helps shape the future of our platform. Fluency in French (written and spoken) to effectively support French-speaking clients and partners.

Full time / London - Hybrid (2-3 days in office) - French Speaking

Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert support to customers and the internal sales team by responding to queries in a timely and accurate manner.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues by gathering technical details, replicating problems, and using internal tools to identify root causes.

  • Collaborate with cross functional teams to escalate complex issues, log bugs, and clearly communicate technical solutions to users of varying technical backgrounds.

  • Provide high priority support and platform overviews on an ad hoc basis to a designated group of strategic accounts.

  • Act as a bridge between internal teams, sharing relevant customer feedback to improve the platform.

  • ​​Identify gaps in resources based on common customer pain points.

  • Educate users on new updates, tools, and best practices to tailor to their use cases

  • Report on key customer service metrics and identify noteworthy trends to the Team Director.

Qualifications:

  • At least 4-5 years of experience in a data analysis customer facing role (customer service, care, or success).

  • Fluency in French/English

  • Background in mobile analytics, consumer behavior, or digital advertising strongly preferred.

  • Passionate about providing exceptional customer experience.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tickets or issues at once.

  • Comfortable working with and supporting global brands across diverse markets.

  • Genuine interest in building and growing a career within customer support.

  • Technical experience in initial troubleshooting of front end bug/network issues.

  • Ability to read and interpret data visualizations or logs to guide troubleshooting.

  • Experience working cross functionally with Product, Engineering, or Data teams.

  • Proactive in spotting recurring issues and patterns in customer inquiries.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as Zendesk, Mailgun, Kibana, and Salesforce.

  • Knowledge in assisting global users with API questions, data import/export execution, and platform integrations.

raw.title: Platform Engineer
raw.description:
Sensor Tower’s digital intelligence platform provides unparalleled insight into market trends, advertising, competitor’s strategies, and consumer/user audience across mobile, web, and gaming. Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide across tech, retail/commerce, entertainment/media, gaming, consumer packaged goods and finance.

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to improve the infrastructure, developer tooling, and delivery workflows used by more than 100 engineers.

The role combines infrastructure and software development, with an approximate 65/35 split. You’ll work on cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, CI/CD, and internal tooling. The goal is to make development and releases more reliable, efficient, and straightforward.

What you’ll do

  • Improve developer experience and engineering productivity by building tools and workflows that make it easier for engineers to develop, test, and ship software.

  • Maintain infrastructure automation with Ansible, Terraform, and Terragrunt.

  • Improve the reliability and performance of our CI/CD workflows.

  • Find the causes of slow builds, failed pipelines, and flaky tests.

  • Develop internal tools, improve test infrastructure, and occasionally work on product features.

  • Improve observability across our infrastructure and delivery workflows using OpenTelemetry, ELK.

  • Leverage AI to improve engineering workflows by building cloud-based agent tools and helping teams adopt effective practices.

Our tech stack

AWS, Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible, Jenkins, Docker, ELK, ClickHouse, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Ruby-on-Rails.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience developing and maintaining complex CI/CD workflows.

  • Software development experience, such as building internal tools, APIs, backend services, or automation.

  • Experience with AWS or another cloud provider.

  • Telemetry and monitoring experience (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Kibana).

  • Strong Computer Science and System Design fundamentals.

  • Willingness to learn and use Ruby and/or Go.

What we’d be particularly excited about

  • Experience optimizing CI build times, especially with Jenkins.

  • Experience with Docker or Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Ruby, Python, or JavaScript.

  • Familiarity with build systems such as Webpack or Gradle.

You don’t need to know every technology in our stack. We value strong technical fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to work on different types of engineering problems.

Founded in 2013, Sensor Tower’s market insights have helped marketers, app developers, and gaming leaders demystify the mobile app ecosystem with visibility into usage, engagement, and paid acquisition strategies. Today, Sensor Tower’s digital market insights platform has expanded to include Gaming, Web, Audience, and Digital Advertising Insights, helping global leaders understand market trends and their competitor’s strategies and audiences across the entire digital ecosystem.

Why Sensor Tower?

We’re seeking a Product Marketing Manager to join our team and help position our data-driven solutions in a rapidly evolving digital ecosystem.

Salary: £60-70K

Hybrid Role (2-3 Days in our London Office)

About the Role

As a Product Marketing Manager (PMM) at Sensor Tower, you’ll play a critical role at the intersection of product, sales, and marketing. You’ll position complex data products with clear, compelling messaging and enable our go-to-market teams to drive growth and adoption.

This is a mid-level role for a well-rounded marketer who thrives on collaboration, and strategic storytelling—someone who understands technology, SaaS, and data products and can communicate their impact clearly.

  • Develop and refine go-to-market strategies for Sensor Tower’s data and insight products, driving awareness and adoption.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Sales, and Marketing teams to position and launch new products and features.

  • Build customer-facing materials (presentations, case studies, one-pagers) that clearly communicate value and unique selling propositions.

  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to inform product messaging and strategy.

  • Partner with Sales to enable teams with the right messaging, collateral, and training.

  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback to influence the product roadmap and marketing initiatives.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in Product Marketing, preferably within tech, SaaS, or data-driven products.

  • Strong understanding of how to market complex or data-rich products.

  • Proven experience working cross-functionally with Sales and Product Management.

  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, effectively communicating with diverse audiences while maintaining a customer-first approach.

Regional Marketing Manager EMEA

Sensor Tower

Location: London, UK

Work arrangement: Hybrid, with 2-3 days per week in the office

Organization: Marketing

Level: Director; initially an individual contributor, with future team leadership

About the role

Sensor Tower is seeking a Regional Marketing Manager to drive marketing across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). Based in London, you will help create and implement Sensor Tower’s regional marketing strategy, building awareness, generating demand, and supporting pipeline growth in partnership with regional Sales and our global Marketing organization.

This is a broad marketing role with an emphasis on product marketing and brand marketing. You will develop a strong grasp of our products and customer use cases, translating complex capabilities into clear, persuasive messaging for EMEA audiences. Working closely with Product, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success, you will contribute regional insights to global launches and adapt global programs for local markets.

This is a director-level position that will begin as a hands-on individual contributor. You will set priorities, write content, and deliver programs directly, while establishing the foundation to build and lead an EMEA marketing team over time.

What you will do

  • Drive the EMEA product marketing strategy and plan, aligning regional priorities with sales goals, global go-to-market strategies, and opportunities across the region.

  • Work with Product and Engineering to understand product capabilities and translate technical information into customer value propositions and relevant use cases.

  • Partner with global Marketing and Product on product and feature launches and beta programs, bringing EMEA buyer needs into planning and leading regional messaging and activation

  • Help plan and execute integrated campaigns across content, email, digital channels, account-based marketing, and events to generate qualified pipeline and support deal progression.

  • Collaborate with other marketing leaders on regional events.

  • Equip regional Sales teams with localized pitch decks, competitive battlecards, product presentations, and case studies that address customer needs and objections.

  • Gather customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights across EMEA. Share actionable findings with global teams to inform product and marketing decisions.

     

  • Establish scalable marketing processes, identify future hiring needs, and build and develop the regional marketing team as the function grows.

What you will bring

  • Significant B2B marketing experience, with a track record of driving regional strategy and delivering results at a senior or director-level scope.

     

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills in English, including the ability to explain complex products and data clearly to different buyer audiences.

  • Experience adapting global strategies for EMEA, with an understanding of regional differences in buying behavior and market needs.

  • The ability to build product knowledge quickly and partner effectively with Product and Engineering on messaging and launches.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and influence, including partnership with regional Sales and global teams across time zones.

  • Experience using CRM, marketing automation, and analytics tools to measure performance and guide decisions.

  • Sound strategic judgment and prioritization, with the willingness to execute directly and the leadership skills to build a team over time.

  • Broad hands-on experience across demand generation, field marketing, content, and account-based programs, with evidence of pipeline impact

Preferred experience

  • Experience in SaaS, MarTech, AdTech, digital market intelligence, or data products.

  • Experience hiring, mentoring, or managing a marketing team.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Looker, or buyer intent platforms.

  • Additional language skills relevant to EMEA markets.

Sensor Tower is seeking a Regional Marketing Manager to drive marketing across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). Based in London, you will help create and implement Sensor Tower’s regional marketing strategy, building awareness, generating demand, and supporting pipeline growth in partnership with regional Sales and our global Marketing organization.

This is a broad marketing role with an emphasis on product marketing and brand marketing. You will develop a strong grasp of our products and customer use cases, translating complex capabilities into clear, persuasive messaging for EMEA audiences. Working closely with Product, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success, you will contribute regional insights to global launches and adapt global programs for local markets.

This is a director-level position that will begin as a hands-on individual contributor. You will set priorities, write content, and deliver programs directly, while establishing the foundation to build and lead an EMEA marketing team over time.

What you will do

  • Drive the EMEA product marketing strategy and plan, aligning regional priorities with sales goals, global go-to-market strategies, and opportunities across the region.

  • Work with Product and Engineering to understand product capabilities and translate technical information into customer value propositions and relevant use cases.

  • Partner with global Marketing and Product on product and feature launches and beta programs, bringing EMEA buyer needs into planning and leading regional messaging and activation

  • Help plan and execute integrated campaigns across content, email, digital channels, account-based marketing, and events to generate qualified pipeline and support deal progression.

  • Collaborate with other marketing leaders on regional events.

  • Equip regional Sales teams with localized pitch decks, competitive battlecards, product presentations, and case studies that address customer needs and objections.

  • Gather customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights across EMEA. Share actionable findings with global teams to inform product and marketing decisions.

     

  • Establish scalable marketing processes, identify future hiring needs, and build and develop the regional marketing team as the function grows.

What you will bring

  • Significant B2B marketing experience, with a track record of driving regional strategy and delivering results at a senior or director-level scope.

     

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills in English, including the ability to explain complex products and data clearly to different buyer audiences.

  • Experience adapting global strategies for EMEA, with an understanding of regional differences in buying behavior and market needs.

  • The ability to build product knowledge quickly and partner effectively with Product and Engineering on messaging and launches.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and influence, including partnership with regional Sales and global teams across time zones.

  • Experience using CRM, marketing automation, and analytics tools to measure performance and guide decisions.

  • Sound strategic judgment and prioritization, with the willingness to execute directly and the leadership skills to build a team over time.

  • Broad hands-on experience across demand generation, field marketing, content, and account-based programs, with evidence of pipeline impact

  • Experience in SaaS, MarTech, AdTech, digital market intelligence, or data products.

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.

Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.

As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

Learn more at Sitecore.com.

About the Role:

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) role at Sitecore is a key role within our sales organisation that will give you the knowledge, skills, and foundation for a long, successful career in technology.

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting Sitecore's growth strategy. It is a chance to use your skills to help shape our future as the leaders in the Digital Experience Marketing space.

You will play an essential role in creating market awareness, identifying prospective customers, qualifying leads and generating new business for the company. You are an ambitious, results driven team player.

What You Will Do:

  • Execute targeted outbound campaigns to identify new contacts, establish need and fit, and arrange a product introduction

  • Manage inbound lead flow

  • Partner with the Sales team to build quality pipeline

  • Stay engaged with prospects and nurture your deals

  • Act as an ambassador and advocate for Sitecore, sharing your passion and knowledge with customers and prospects

  • Arranging discovery calls and well-qualified product demonstrations for the Field Sales and Pre-Sales teams

What You Need to Succeed:

  • Positive and energetic communication skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills

  • Genuinely curious, self-motivated, creative, results-driven, solution-oriented, direct, and driven to succeed

  • Comfortable making cold calls

  • Thrive in a metrics-driven organisation

  • Ability to analyse industry trends and craft relevant messaging

  • Curious personality with a desire to grow a long-term career in enterprise sales

  • Additional European langauges highly advantageous

Additional Skills That Could Set You Apart:

  • Outbound and lead generation experience in a B2B environment

  • Passionate about technology and what it can do for society, selling technology and redefining a market segment

  • Previous tech industry experience or experience in sales development, tele-marketing and/or sales

We are committed to equal employment opportunity without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other local legally protected characteristic.

raw.title: Data Engineer
raw.description:
Who are we?

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting

Smarkets runs one of the world’s most sophisticated prediction markets, handling over £29 billion in volume since 2010 and engaging 200,000+ traders globally. We’re a technology company that happens to revolutionise betting - from sports to political markets, to delivering the sharpest prices and the fairest odds.

Our stack is designed for scale, reliability, and speed: Linux, Kafka, Postgres, Kubernetes, with Python 3, C++, Rust and React powering our platform. We build infrastructure that institutions trust while keeping trading accessible to everyone. Our edge? We’ve thrived through every market cycle, competitor, and industry revolution.

At the heart of our success are our people. We create a high-performance environment where exceptional talent can thrive, blending deep business experience with a commercial mindset to drive strategic growth.

If you’re ready to help shape the future of prediction markets with cutting-edge technology and a customer-first philosophy, Smarkets is where you belong.

The Team

The Data Team is responsible for taking the wealth of data that Smarkets generates and using it to drive insights which improve the business. Since Smarkets produces a huge amount of data - including sports event data, payments information, order flow and user analytics - there are many opportunities for the team to add real business value.

The team’s responsibilities currently span across three different areas:

  • Data Engineering: development and maintenance of ETL pipelines, services and APIs, and data-related infrastructure like Redshift or BigQuery;

  • Data Science and Machine Learning: data exploration, ML models training and ML Ops to extract new insights from data;

  • Analytics and Reporting: creation of data models and dashboards as well as automation of reporting pipelines for different teams, stakeholders and third-parties.

In a typical week, a data engineer in the Data team would:

  • Add a new python ETL pipeline that segments users interested in specific sports through analysing behaviour which streamlines and tailors marketing communications to those users;

  • Develop a new endpoint to a Flask API, add unit tests, and deploy the new version of the API into our production Kubernetes cluster;

  • Train and evaluate an ML model to identify certain user patterns and provide it as service to other engineering teams in a Flask API;

Team Tech Stack

Our current technology stack primarily includes Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Kafka, Python, Flask/FastAPI, Postgres, AWS Redshift, dbt, Google Bigquery, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Search, Kibana, Lightdash.

About the Role:

You will work very closely with the Data team lead and the other team members who will be assisting you whenever needed, making your integration in the company as smooth as possible.

The Data team works in an organised way using Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira and regular standups. You will find an environment where you have a clear engineering direction, can focus on your work and hone your skills as a data engineer through exciting projects. You will always be able to count on the support of many engineers across the company.

What you will do:

As a member of the data team, your responsibilities will include contributions to:

  • Developing and maintaining our Data ETL pipelines, some of which are real-time. The pipelines are fundamental to helping teams and stakeholders understand and drive business direction. Data components can also be user facing e.g. sending notifications to users;

  • Ensuring our data lake is kept in a healthy state, particularly our data warehouses: Redshift and Bigquery;

  • Developing and maintaining Flask services and Postgres databases within the Data team to provide access to data or manage certain business entities relevant to Data.

  • Assisting the different teams in the company with reporting, especially when it comes to automated reporting pipelines.

  • Doing data exploration and training & deploying ML models used to perform different kinds of user segmentation, detect operational anomalies or estimate important business quantities. In particular maintain and improve our existing recommender service that provides users with suggestions on new sport competitions.

Role Requirements:

What we are looking for in you:

  • 3+ years of experience

  • You have an understanding of developing ETL pipelines using Python frameworks such as luigi or airflow;

  • You have experience with the development of Python-based REST APIs / services and their integration with databases (e.g. Postgres);

  • You are familiar with the key tools of the Python data science stack, e.g. Pandas, Numpy and scikit-learn;

  • Some experience with training and deploying ML models;

  • You enjoy writing elegant, well-tested and maintainable code;

  • You are a team player that enjoys contributing to the success of the team in a proactive and friendly environment;

  • You have a bachelor’s in Computer Science, Math or equivalent field, or possess relevant experience.

Our Values

Our values are at the heart of everything we do - guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect what we expect of ourselves and each other to deliver the best results, while fostering a positive, high-performing environment:

  • Push to Win: We set ambitious goals and relentlessly pursue them, always striving for excellence.

  • Make Others Better: We lift each other up, share knowledge, and celebrate team success over individual achievement.

  • Give a Shit: We care deeply about our work, our users, and the impact we make.

  • Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard.

  • Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us.

Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn’t you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment.

Perks & Benefits
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious - united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win.

Our benefits are designed around Health, Wealth,and Development, supporting you both professionally and personally.

These include:

  • Stock Options: Vest over 4 years - your success is our success.

  • Pension Scheme: Competitive plan via Aviva, with up to 6% matched contributions if you opt in.

  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to keep you and your family healthy.

  • Enhanced Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave to support you through life’s most important moments.

  • Stay Fuelled: Enjoy fresh, chef-made breakfast and lunch every day, plus a constant supply of fruit, snacks, tea, coffee and soft drinks — because great work starts with great food.

  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme: Support for sustainable commuting and staying active.

  • Learning & Development: £1,000 annual education budget for courses, conferences, books, or training.

  • Holiday: 25 days paid leave + bank holidays, with the option to carry over 5 days.

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home to fit your lifestyle.

  • Team Energy: Regular socials, hackathons, and events — because collaboration and fun go hand-in-hand.

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer and celebrate diversity in all its forms. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to accommodate your needs.

You’ll join the DevOps Infrastructure Team, responsible for real-time distributed systems that power our trading engine-systems that are always-on, ultra-low latency, and demand resilience at scale.

You won’t just be building infrastructure-you’ll be crafting platform capabilities to streamline how engineers build, test, deploy, and run applications across our hybrid estate of self-hosted, co-located hardware and AWS cloud.

This is a role where infrastructure meets engineering productivity: part DevOps, part Platform, 100% mission-critical.

What You’ll Do

  • Platform Enablement: Design and maintain internal tooling and workflows that improve the developer experience across deployment pipelines, observability and testing environments.

  • Empower Developers (DevEx): Automate workflows, streamline CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab), and ensure fast, safe, and reliable deployments across environments.

  • Infrastructure Automation: Build, manage, and scale Kubernetes-based microservices infrastructure on AWS using Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code best practices.

  • Developer Experience: Collaborate closely with product engineers to provide reliable, low-friction paths for development, testing, and deployment.

  • Operational Excellence: Monitor, debug, and ensure the stability of our systems with robust alerting and logging using Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK.

  • System Reliability: Optimize performance and availability for high-throughput, low-latency services that power the betting exchange.

  • Collaborative Delivery: Participate in on-call rotations, incident reviews, and cross-functional projects with engineering and SRE teams.

  • Security & Compliance: Contribute to secure system design and operational practices that support industry-standard compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc).

    What You Bring

  • 2–4 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering roles.

  • Strong Linux systems administration background.

  • Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting.

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS (or other public clouds).

  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and production-scale deployment.

  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) and a passion for improving the build/deploy process.

  • A pragmatic mindset that balances ideal solutions with immediate business needs.

  • Curiosity and initiative to explore new technologies and bring fresh thinking into the team.

Bonus Points For

  • Exposure to Nix-based Build environments.

  • Understanding of self-hosted or hybrid infrastructure models.

  • Experience with ArgoCD, Backstage or internal developer portals.

  • Knowledge of Rust or C++ environments.

  • Interest in performance engineering and low-latency systems.

Our Stack

  • Languages: Python, Bash, Rust, NodeJS

  • Datastores: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Nix, Jenkins, GitLab CI

  • Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Sentry

Our Values

Our values are at the heart of everything we do - guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect what we expect of ourselves and each other to deliver the best results, while fostering a positive, high-performing environment:

  • Push to Win: We set ambitious goals and relentlessly pursue them, always striving for excellence.

  • Make Others Better: We lift each other up, share knowledge, and celebrate team success over individual achievement.

  • Give a Shit: We care deeply about our work, our users, and the impact we make.

  • Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard.

  • Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us.

Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn’t you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment.

Perks & Benefits
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious - united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win.

Our benefits are designed around Health, Wealth,and Development, supporting you both professionally and personally.

These include:

  • Stock Options: Vest over 4 years, your success is our success.

  • Pension Scheme: Competitive plan via Aviva, with up to 6% matched contributions if you opt in.

  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to keep you and your family healthy.

  • Enhanced Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave to support you through life’s most important moments.

  • Stay Fuelled: Enjoy fresh, chef-made breakfast and lunch every day, plus a constant supply of fruit, snacks, tea, coffee and soft drinks, because great work starts with great food.

  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme: Support for sustainable commuting and staying active.

  • Learning & Development: £1,000 annual education budget for courses, conferences, books, or training.

  • Holiday: 25 days paid leave + bank holidays, with the option to carry over 5 days.

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home to fit your lifestyle.

  • Global Working: Work from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days a year.

  • Team Energy: Regular socials, hackathons, and events — because collaboration and fun go hand-in-hand.

What happens next​

We aim to have a simple and speedy hiring process and we want to make sure that we are right for you as much as the other way around.

  • Let’s chat - Quick chat with our team about your experience and the role

  • Meet the Hiring Manager - Introduction to your potential Manager

  • Technical Interview - Live Coding Interview + System Design Interview

  • In Office Interview - Lunch with other colleagues in the team + LT Chat

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer and celebrate diversity in all its forms. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to accommodate your needs.

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Job Summary: Snyk's Core R&D organization builds the infrastructure, platform, and shared systems that every product team at Snyk depends on. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll take on complex, ambiguous problems end to end: designing the solution, building it, and owning it in production. This is a role for someone who wants real technical ownership and a direct hand in mentoring the engineers around them, at a company where AI agents are rewriting how software gets built and security has to keep pace.

About the Team: You'll join one of Snyk's Core R&D engineering teams, the group responsible for the shared infrastructure and platform capabilities that power Snyk's products. The team partners closely with product engineering across the company, and reports up through R&D engineering leadership.

raw.title: Manager, Sales Development (1 year FTC)
raw.description:
Role Summary

 

The Sales Development Manager is responsible for, but may not be limited to, the management of all of Sophos’ UK based Sales Development Representatives. This comprises a team of 8 SDRs across the EMEA region.  

 

Key to this role is the ability to develop new sales skills and thinking across the team, oversee change programmes and build strong partnerships with other leaders in Sales, Marketing, Operations Team and the wider global SDR community.  

It will also require assisting the SDR Director in driving innovation, bringing a new strategic focus to the function and increasing the quality and productivity of the work performed by the wider EMEA SDR Team. As part of this, support for SDRs outside of the UK will be required.  

 

The aim of this role is to build and manage a team of highly adaptable, energised and productive SDRs, capable of consistently delivering a high volume of quality sales opportunities for the Sophos Sales teams and its Channel Partners to successfully progress to order. It is also to increase the levels of communication with senior stakeholders and, through working with them, create new synergies, stronger working practices, and new levels of value for those on both the Sales and Marketing sides of the SDR team.  

 

They must also take responsibility for integrating the team into the wider Sales & Marketing communities, increasing collaboration across the EMEA SDR function, and delivering continued improvement at both a team and individual level. Within this, their skills and experience as a coach or mentor will be essential.  

 

With ambitious plans to innovate and redefine how the EMEA SDR team is seen, performs and defines its success. The job holder must be unafraid of change, able to build a collective purpose, and passionately believe in the importance of Sales Development as a key driver of business growth.  

 

The role requires office attendance in Manchester (3 fixed days per week; Monday, Wednesday and Thursday). 


What Will You Do:

  • Team Management: Is accountable for the performance and results of the team. Monitors, tracks and reports on KPIs. Performs regular team meetings and 1-1s. Promotes success, but also addresses underperformance. Uses all of this, in combination, to ensure team targets are hit. 

  • Team Development: Sets performance standards and, within wider (EMEA) context, targets for team. Develops new skills and awareness, unlocks potential, enables progression and delivers, as part of a wider coaching culture, regular coaching sessions. 

  • Peer Engagement: Engages positively with other Sales and Marketing leaders. Invites their feedback and shapes their thinking to improve the performance and financial contribution of the SDR team. Presents regular performance updates, new ideas and future plans as part of the Sales and Marketing Management meeting cycles. Able to learn from, raise debate with and positively influence the way this group views and works with the SDR team. 

  • Sales Methods and Mindset: Builds a sales mentality and methodology throughout. Readies team members for Sales roles. Works with enablement team to design and deliver training programmes that are fit for a modern, progressive and future facing SDR team. 

  • Maintains Motivation: Sustains energy and purpose across the team through positive leadership, spotting and celebrating good performance, setting meaningful goals, maintaining a strong supportive presence, and providing attractive incentives/SPIFFs. 

  • Collaborates: Works in tandem with the EMEA SDR Manager to enable and create more time for strategic development of the SDR function. Forms partnerships with colleagues in Marketing and Sales to ensure campaigns are successful (ROI targets are hit), hand offs are seamless (Sales Acceptance Rates are high), and the UKIN SDR team is helping drive revenue growth (high Closed Won rates are sustained). Builds close and productive working relationships with others across the Global SDR Leadership team. Communicates frequently with own team and establishes a strong team ethos across the group. 

  • Enable Innovation: To achieve higher standards, new levels of success and greater collaboration, is willing to experiment, benchmark and take risks. Is unafraid to break with traditional models of acting and thinking. Regularly creates, shares and, after getting buy in, implements own ideas for improvement. 

  • Selection and Onboarding: Successfully recruits high calibre and high potential candidates. Designs and arranges extended induction programmes that enable new recruits to add value from early in their Sophos careers. 

  • Inspire Success: Leads from the front, brings energy, maintains credibility, ensures professionalism and gets people to see new possibilities.

     

What will you bring:

  • Has had or has a strong desire to perform a Management role. 

  • 3+ Years experience within a sales environment. 

  • Successful track record in delivering targets.  

  • Has collaborated with, influenced and achieved productive working relationships with Senior Stakeholders.  

  • Defined, measured, interpreted and presented performance goals. 

  • Has successfully overseen change projects.  

  • Has used coaching to drive positive change and realise potential in others. 

  • Used to managing mixed priorities and activities. 

  • Lead, create purpose, maintain motivation. 

  • Manage/maximise performance and results. 

  • Collaboration. 

  • Recruit, develop and retain talent. 

  • Communication – individual, team and stakeholder. 

  • Emotional intelligence. 

  • Uses data to inform decision making. 

  • Prioritise, delegate and empower.

  • Adapt, innovate, create. 

  • Define and raise standards of performance.

#B2

What does remote mean at Sophos?
Sophos supports flexible ways of working, with many roles offered remotely and others working in a hybrid model. For remote roles, you may work remotely within the location specified in the job posting. Candidates must reside in and be authorized to work in that location. Our teams collaborate across locations and time zones, using technology to stay connected and deliver results.

 

Our Commitment To You

Sophos welcomes applicants with diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds. We believe great ideas come from different ways of thinking, and we are committed to building a workplace where people can contribute, grow, and succeed.

We evaluate all candidates based on job-related skills, qualifications, and experience, and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities consistent with applicable laws and regulations.

raw.title: LNG Commodity Owner
raw.description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

LNG Commodity Owner, Sparta Commodities

Singapore, Geneva or London

 

LNG moves on netbacks, shipping and a handful of hubs that rarely agree with each other. Plenty of people write about that. We want the person who builds the system that connects all the pieces of the puzzle, and then puts it in front of traders and makes it sell.

Sparta is building the data platform that energy traders, analysts and commercial teams use to make faster, better decisions. We cover forward curves, price assessments, market intelligence and trade flows across the global energy complex. LNG is our next vertical, and we want an exceptional builder to lead it.

 

The role

 

This is a builder's seat. It isn't just an analyst position, a sales role or a thought-leadership seat. You will be leading the development of Sparta's LNG offering, from the first netback model to the AI analyst that puts together a forward view on LNG markets autonomously, working with our engineering, product, data and commercial teams. You will set the direction and stay hands-on: prototyping, testing and shipping with the team, not handing over a spec and waiting. Building on its own is not enough. The job is to build a product LNG desks will pay for, which means time with clients is as much a part of the role as time in the code.

 

We are looking for someone who knows LNG deeply: JKM, TTF and Henry Hub relationships, netbacks and delivered economics, shipping and regasification costs, cargo arbitrage between basins and contract structures. Your job is to turn that knowledge into products. Expect a good part of your week to be hands-on with AI coding tools: prototyping a pricing model in Python, standing up a data pipeline, creating market-leading knowledge graphs that an AI agent follows and testing its answers against desk judgement. The rest goes on working with engineers to harden, scale and ship what the team builds.

 

The role reports to our Head of Commodities.

 

What you'll do

 

Building products, data pipelines and AI agents (~55% of role)

  • Lead the design and build of Sparta's LNG product set: netbacks, arbitrage routes, delivered price curves and the analytical tools that sit on top of them

  • Build the LNG expert inside Leonidas with our AI engineers: the tools it calls, the domain rules it follows and the knowledge base behind them

  • Build automated products with the team: a daily LNG brief autonomously written by AI analyst, alerts on the curves and spreads that matter, and the quality checks that catch errors before clients see them

  • Build evaluation sets that test the AI against desk judgement, and keep them passing as the product changes

  • Build the data pipelines behind the vertical with data and engineering colleagues: price inputs, freight and regas assumptions, vessel and terminal data, route onboarding and automated data quality checks

  • Ship to production with engineering through our normal process (pull requests, code review, tests, CI), and hold the bar on scale, security and reliability

 

Owning the LNG vertical (~25% of role)

  • Own the LNG vertical end to end: what we build, how well it works and how it performs commercially

  • Set and sequence the LNG roadmap with product and technology, so clients get something useful early and more every few weeks

  • Write the rules: the LNG conventions, definitions and desk judgement that every Sparta product and agent follows

  • Lead the people working on LNG across product, engineering and data: set priorities, unblock them and raise the bar on quality

  • Be the person the business comes to for any LNG decision

 

Building a product clients pay for (~20% of role)

  • Lead discovery conversations and technical demos with LNG trading desks, analysts and commercial teams, and use what they tell you to decide what to build next

  • Work with sales and account management on the first LNG deals and on adding LNG to existing oil and freight accounts: you bring the market credibility and the product, sales runs the commercial process

  • Give sales a clear account of what the product does and why a desk would pay for it, so they can sell it without you in the room

  • Represent Sparta at industry events, conferences and client visits as the LNG expert

 

What we're looking for

 

Required

  • Deep LNG market expertise: strong working knowledge of global LNG pricing (JKM, TTF, Henry Hub and the relationships between them), netbacks and delivered economics, shipping and regasification costs, cargo arbitrage between basins and contract structures

  • A track record of building, not just specifying: tools, models, pipelines or products you built hands-on and that other people rely on

  • Strong Python and SQL, and comfort with the rest of a modern stack: APIs, databases, cloud services and version control

  • Heavy, daily use of AI coding tools to prototype and ship far faster than a traditional build cycle, and the judgement to spot where an LLM gets the market wrong

  • Ownership and drive: you scope the problem, pull in the right people, get it built and shipped, and fix it when it breaks, without waiting for a detailed spec

  • Credible in front of trading desks: able to run a discovery call and a technical demo, and to hear what a client will pay for and what they won't

  • Experience leading or working closely with engineers, and the technical credibility to set direction with them

  • Experience in a commodity-facing role within energy trading, data/analytics, financial services or a closely related field

  • Ability to turn market complexity into rules, tests and code that make an AI agent answer like a good desk analyst

 

Desirable

  • Experience building AI agents or LLM applications: tool calling, prompt design, retrieval and evaluation

  • Experience shipping work to production alongside an engineering team (code review, testing, CI/CD)

  • Familiarity with LNG data sources: price assessments, vessel tracking and shipping data, terminal and regasification data

  • Experience with pricing, data or analytics platforms in the energy space, or with building one from scratch

  • An existing network within the LNG trading community

 

What success looks like

 

In your first six months, you will have:

  • Led the build and launch of the first version of Sparta's LNG offering: netbacks, arbitrage routes and delivered price curves in clients' hands

  • Built, with the AI team, an LNG expert in Leonidas that answers the way a good desk analyst would, with an evaluation set that proves it

  • Launched at least one automated product, such as a daily brief or a set of alerts, that runs every day

  • Written the LNG rules every Sparta product and agent follows

  • Set up, with data and engineering, pipelines that run and check themselves, so the vertical scales without manual work

  • Put the product in front of LNG desks, helped sales land the first LNG clients, and fed what the market told you back into the roadmap

 

Is this you?

 

This role is for you if you'd rather build the tool than write the note about it, you like being hands-on, you make the people around you build faster too, and you measure what you've built by whether a desk will pay for it. It probably isn't for you if the part of the job you enjoy most is publishing your market view, or you'd rather hand over a spec than help build what's in it.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.
