Senior Electrical Design Manager

 

Location - United Kingdom

 

Role Summary

 

As Senior Manager, Electrical Design, you will act as a senior electrical technical authority within STACK Infrastructure's EMEA Design & Engineering function. You will define, govern and continuously improve STACK's electrical engineering standards, helping to ensure consistent delivery of the European Reference Design across regions.

Working at platform level, you will shape electrical resilience, capacity modelling, grid interface strategy, power distribution architecture and energy performance alignment across mission-critical data centre developments. This is a high-impact role for an experienced electrical design leader who can balance technical excellence, commercial judgement and future-ready thinking for hyperscale environments.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Own and maintain the electrical architecture within STACK's European Reference Design, including utility interface, HV/LV configuration, generator strategy, UPS architecture and modular power building block standards.

  • Define and govern electrical resilience models, ensuring power distribution standards remain scalable, consistent and aligned to customer, operational and investment requirements.

  • Validate capacity modelling assumptions, including MVA to MW IT conversion, load growth, diversity assumptions and partial versus full build-out scenarios.

  • Provide senior technical oversight at design stage gates, reviewing and challenging consultant designs for compliance, resilience integrity, constructability, maintainability and client requirements.

  • Shape platform-level grid and infrastructure strategy, including utility connection configuration, on-site substations, dual-feed resilience positioning, generator capacity and autonomy assumptions.

  • Support technical due diligence and early feasibility activity by assessing power availability, infrastructure risks and abnormal assumptions before underwriting or investment decisions.

  • Approve structured deviations from electrical standards and lead peer reviews for high-risk or high-complexity schemes across the EMEA portfolio.

  • Develop the roadmap for future electrical requirements, including higher rack densities, AI-driven load profiles, liquid cooling implications, energy efficiency evolution and alternative generation technologies where relevant.

  • Partner with commercial, development, delivery and engineering teams to evaluate CapEx drivers, specification changes, yield opportunities and investor-level technical risk.

  • Develop and maintain electrical engineering standards, technical guidance, Basis of Design inputs, QA checklists and peer review frameworks, ensuring consistency across regions.

 

What You'll Bring

 

  • Significant experience in mission-critical, hyperscale data centre or similarly complex electrical engineering environments.

  • Deep technical expertise across MV/LV distribution systems, generator and UPS topology, resilience strategy, capacity modelling and grid connection processes.

  • Strong understanding of electrical design trade-offs, including resilience, scalability, energy performance, constructability, maintainability and commercial optimisation.

  • Experience working with developer, hyperscale, investor-backed or large-scale infrastructure platforms is highly advantageous.

  • Confidence reviewing complex consultant designs, challenging assumptions and translating technical risk into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.

  • A governance-led approach to standards, documentation, version control, QA and structured decision-making across multi-region programmes.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align technical, commercial, delivery, operations and investment teams.

  • A degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. Chartered Engineer status, or progress towards chartership, is preferred.

  • A collaborative leadership style, with the ability to mentor others, promote technical excellence and support continuous improvement across design practices.

 

What We Offer

raw.description:
Senior Mechanical Design Manager

 

Location – London

 

Role Summary

 

As Senior Manager, Mechanical Design, you will be a senior mechanical technical authority within STACK Infrastructure's EMEA Design & Engineering function, helping define, govern and continuously improve the mechanical engineering standards that shape our European data centre platform.

You will own key elements of STACK’s cooling strategy, mechanical plant standards, thermal performance and energy efficiency approach, ensuring the European Reference Design is applied consistently across regions while remaining scalable, commercially optimised and ready for future customer requirements.

Working closely with Engineering, Design, Development, Delivery, Commercial, Construction, Commissioning and regional project teams, you will bring senior technical oversight, practical challenge and clear guidance to complex mission-critical data centre projects across EMEA.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Act as the senior mechanical technical authority for STACK EMEA, defining and maintaining the mechanical components of the European Reference Design and future iterations.

  • Own the mechanical cooling strategy and plant standards, including air-cooled solutions, chilled water systems, liquid cooling integration and hybrid deployment approaches.

  • Define modular mechanical building block principles that support scalability, phasing flexibility, resilience and STACK’s platform design philosophy.

  • Provide senior technical review at key RIBA stage gates, challenging consultant designs for compliance with standards, energy efficiency, constructability and operability.

  • Review and approve structured deviations from mechanical standards, ensuring design decisions are clearly governed, documented and aligned with platform objectives.

  • Support regional design and delivery teams with complex mechanical issues during design, PCSA, construction and commissioning phases.

  • Provide technical input into client specification reviews and support structured responses to changes in rack density, inlet temperatures, flow rates and other hyperscale requirements.

  • Monitor emerging cooling technologies, higher-density deployments and AI-driven load growth, helping define a future-ready roadmap for liquid cooling and next-generation mechanical systems.

  • Support sustainability and energy optimisation initiatives, including plant sizing, PUE performance, capacity planning and improvements that enhance MW yield and platform competitiveness.

  • Partner with commercial, development and investment teams to explain mechanical CapEx drivers, quantify the impact of specification changes and support informed decision-making.

  • Develop and maintain mechanical design standards, technical guidance notes, Basis of Design alignment, QA checklists, peer review frameworks and BIM-related mechanical requirements.

  • Translate complex mechanical engineering topics into clear, practical insight for senior stakeholders, regional teams and cross-functional partners.

 

What You'll Bring

 

  • Significant experience in mechanical engineering within mission-critical, hyperscale data centre or similarly complex technical environments.

  • Deep technical expertise across chilled water systems, plant optimisation, air-cooled and hybrid cooling solutions, liquid cooling integration, thermal modelling and capacity planning.

  • Strong understanding of data centre cooling strategy, resilience, scalability, partial-load and full-build-out assumptions, energy efficiency and PUE optimisation.

  • Experience reviewing and challenging consultant designs, leading technical governance and reducing design changes during construction.

  • Commercial awareness, with the ability to balance energy performance, CapEx efficiency, expandability, MW yield and long-term platform value.

  • Confidence working across regional and cross-functional teams, including Design, Engineering, Development, Delivery, Commercial, Construction and Commissioning.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to turn technical complexity into clear recommendations for technical, commercial and executive audiences.

  • A degree or equivalent experience in Mechanical Engineering. Chartered status, or progress towards chartership, would be advantageous.

  • Experience in a developer, hyperscale, investor-backed or large-scale infrastructure platform would be beneficial.

  • A structured, collaborative and improvement-focused approach, with the judgement to make clear decisions under pressure.

This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social.

As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey!

Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell.

What You'll Be Doing

  • UX flow design for entire game experience

  • Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations

  • Involved in pioneering a modern workflow and optimise assets for performance

  • Discover and manage external partners where needed

What You Have

  • 5+ years of experience shipping UI/UX design for apps/games

  • Portfolio showcasing end-to-end UI/UX work on game projects, with examples of UI and UX flows

  • Proven ability to translate game design requirements into intuitive and visually stunning UI solutions

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers, game designers and artists

  • Passionate about both UI & UX design

  • Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.)

  • Proficient understanding of Graphic Design and Typography

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • At the forefront with AI tools and actively experimenting

  • Enjoys TCGs

Where You'll Be

This opportunity is based in our London office, and because we value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions, it is mostly an office‑based role.

Supercell New Games

This is a dedicated environment for building from zero and shaped around a core belief: the best developers don’t need more direction, they need more freedom and fewer barriers. This is where games get the space they need to become cultural phenomenons.

Players are waiting for your vision and ambition to build the next forever game a.k.a. the best work of your career. We back this up with creative and operational autonomy, and the infrastructure, capital, and experience needed to take a game from an idea to global scale.

This is not for everyone. Building towards a billion-dollar game is going to be hard. But let's not kid ourselves: it should also be fun.

You build the rocket. We bring the launchpad.

Game-changing Financial Model

Supercell is great with stuff around benefits and wellbeing, but most importantly you get to focus on what matters: making games. Skip the Venture Capital pitch decks and looking at runway spreadsheets. In exchange, we're offering a compensation model that makes this opportunity financially life-changing.

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Relocation? Yes!

The Supercell Recruitment team

Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.

Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.

If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you.

What will I be doing? ‍‍👩‍💻👨‍💻

With product-market fit proven, we're looking for a mission-driven, top-performing enterprise seller to join our commercial team. This is a key role on our EMEA team: you'll scale our presence across Europe, drive deeper market penetration, and grow Sylvera's revenue by helping customers solve fundamental challenges.

Specific responsibilities will include:

  • Build and own a territory across enterprise and mid-market prospects

  • Become a technical expert and trusted point of reference for customers and prospects

  • Generate net-new opportunities and close new business

  • Develop and execute outbound strategies to build and nurture pipeline

  • Own the full sales cycle, from first touch to close

  • Build and grow relationships with multiple stakeholders to drive deals over the line

  • Bring the voice of the customer back to our product team

We're looking for someone who: 🧠💚

  • Has 3+ years of closing experience selling complex solutions as a top performer, consistently meeting and exceeding quota

  • Has sold into multiple European markets and brings an existing network

  • Sells with a structured but creative approach: you generate your own pipeline, qualify from scratch, build champions, and navigate complex org structures

  • Is comfortable with ambiguity and confident exercising sound judgement

  • Is hungry to learn, be coached, and become a world-class seller

  • Can travel regularly for client visits and events

  • Is genuinely curious about solving customer problems

  • Cares deeply about the climate and the earth's ecosystems

We'd like someone highly ambitious, motivated and eager to propel their career forward. We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

Own it: We make new mistakes. We build on the momentum of our wins and reflect on and learn from our failures.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the business, notably in technology, data, product, commercial teams

  • Ensuring that critical quality assurance processes are upheld to maintain our status as the markets most trusted data provider with our carbon project assessments

  • Promote and uphold best practices in the team, including keeping customer value at the heart of what we do

We’re looking for someone who: 🧠💚

  • Based in London (this role is on-site, with five days a week in our London office)

  • Has deep critical thinking skills and the ability to apply logical principles in order to quickly determine actionable solution pathways to complex problems

  • Has experience delivering data insights as well as innovating new analytics

  • Has established knowledge of quantitative analysis techniques and high familiarity with common quantitative tools for example Sheets, GIS software, SQL, Python, etc.

  • Excellent English written communication and collaboration skills

  • Fast learner, self-starter, intellectually curious, quantitative and ready to get up-to-speed in a complex and technical domain

  • Takes initiative, excellent time-management skills, and adapts easily to change especially when operating toward deadlines

  • Is a self-starter who thrives in constantly evolving environments, ideally with early-stage experience

  • Cares deeply about the climate and ecosystems of the Earth

  • Additional language skills in Spanish, Portuguese or Japanese are advantageous

  • We’d like someone highly ambitious, motivated and eager to propel their career forward. We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description

Benefits 💰

- Equity in a rapidly growing startup

- Private Health Insurance and Life Assurance

- Unlimited annual leave - and encouragement to actually use it!

- Enhanced parental leave

- Up to 20 days paid sick leave

- No corners cut in having the best tech to do your job

- Access to Mental Health support

- Monthly team socials

Location 🌍

- London, Old Street.

Our values 🙌

  • Own it: We make new mistakes. We build on the momentum of our wins and reflect on and learn from our failures.

  • Stay curious: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and the opportunities ahead of us.

raw.title: Senior Strategic Account Manager
raw.description:
About Transmit Security

Transmit Security protects large enterprises from fraud and identity attacks. Our platform spans Mosaic (SaaS identity and fraud orchestration), FlexID (on-prem IAM), standalone fraud prevention and detection, and Agentic Trust, which secures AI agents that act on behalf of customers. Our technology is recognized by analysts, and our buyers are CISOs, fraud and financial crime leaders, and identity and digital channel owners. The product is ahead of the brand.

About the role

Own the commercial relationships with a focused portfolio of up to five major financial services customers across EMEA. Your priority will be to protect existing revenue, secure renewals, and grow these relationships through cross-sell and upsell opportunities.

You will build on established customer relationships, develop executive sponsorship, and uncover opportunities across business units and geographies. This role combines long-term account development with direct responsibility for negotiating and closing renewals and expansion business. Based in London, you will visit customer offices in the UK and internationally.

Location: Remote - London, UK

What you will do

  • Own renewal and expansion sales for your named accounts, taking responsibility for revenue retention and account growth.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans covering renewal milestones, stakeholder relationships, customer priorities, retention risks, and expansion opportunities.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and stakeholders across business, technology, security, and procurement teams, extending engagement across customer divisions and global offices.
  • Identify and lead complex cross-sell and upsell opportunities, typically valued at $500K or more, from qualification and business case development through negotiation and close.
  • Own expansion pipeline development and progression, coordinating internal resources to uncover opportunities and advance customer decisions.
  • Partner with technical and customer-facing teams to demonstrate business value, address risks to renewal, and ensure customer commitments are understood and supported.
  • Lead commercial discussions and coordinate internal stakeholders through proposals, procurement, contract negotiations, and renewal execution.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity records, renewal timelines, and revenue forecasts; communicate account progress, risks, and support needs.
  • Represent customer priorities internally, sharing insights with Product, Support, and Sales to strengthen customer outcomes and identify future growth opportunities.

What you will bring

  • 8+ years of enterprise software sales or strategic account management experience, with direct responsibility for renewals and expansion revenue.
  • A demonstrated record of retaining and growing major enterprise accounts, supported by measurable renewal, expansion, and sales target results.
  • Experience managing relationships with large banks or similarly complex financial services organizations, navigating multiple business units, buying groups, and procurement processes.
  • Proven ability to lead complex commercial negotiations and close substantial cross-sell and upsell opportunities.
  • Strong account planning and relationship development skills, including building executive sponsorship and engaging stakeholders across functions and geographies.
  • The commercial judgment and initiative to identify opportunities, build pipeline, and progress deals while coordinating internal resources.
  • Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to connect technical solutions to customer business priorities and measurable value.
  • A collaborative approach, personal accountability, and the ability to maintain momentum through complex sales cycles.

Preferred experience

Experience selling cybersecurity, identity security, fraud prevention, or related enterprise technology solutions into financial services organizations.

Transmit Security is committed to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of Diversity and Inclusion. Our human capital is the most valuable asset we have. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, inventiveness, innovation, self-expression, unique capabilities and talent that our employees invest in their work represents a significant part of not only our Culture, but our Reputation and Achievements as well.  We encourage diversity and embrace our employees' differences in age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique.

raw.title: Internal Communications Director
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays.


About the team

Embedded right at the heart of the business, our Internal Communications function bridges the gap between high-level strategy and everyday culture. Reporting directly to our Chief People Officer (CPO), you will be the connective tissue connecting our executive table to every single desk across the globe; turning business priorities into shared cultural momentum.

About the role

The Internal Communications Director will be a vital culture carrier for Trustly and the internal voice of our executive leadership. You will own how we communicate across the business through three core pillars: aligning our organisation to our growth and performance strategy; stewarding change through transparent, radically clear, and compelling two-way dialogue; and amplifying and driving momentum behind our culture.

We view listening as just as important as talking. We are keen to meet leaders who build relevant, high-impact communication strategies grounded in real employee insights and data. You will be a curious and deeply connected leader; wired into the business where work actually gets done, championing our product-led growth, and translating complex milestones into shared understanding.

We are looking for an innovative, tech- and AI-forward communicator who leverages emerging tools not only to drive the efficiency of communications, but to elevate the employee experience through greater ease, relevance, and personalisation.

This role is based in our London office.


What you’ll do

  • Architect the Global Narrative: Own the global internal comms strategy end-to-end across three high-impact pillars: leadership voice, change management, and culture amplification.

  • Be the Executive Megaphone: Serve as the trusted thinking partner and internal voice of our CEO; crafting punchy, transparent executive memos, town hall moments, and town-wide fireside chats that inspire action.

  • Spark Real Two-Way Dialogue: Kill the corporate echo chamber. Build robust feedback loops, pulse checks, and listening rituals that foster psychological safety and make people feel truly heard.

  • Unearth the Stories Behind the Ship: Embed with product, engineering, and commercial teams to surface the human victories, experiments, and lessons behind our rapid growth.

  • Lead Through Transformation: Anchor our people through hyper-growth, reorganizations, and big strategic pivots with calm clarity, empathy, and impeccable timing.

  • Pioneer the Comms Tech Stack: Hack the medium. Test and scale cutting-edge AI copy tools, tailored communications bots, and dynamic media (podcasts, interactive video briefs, micro-updates).

  • Unify the Business: Partner seamlessly across C-suite leaders and cross-functional teams to keep our narrative aligned, transparent, and impossibly sharp.

Who you are

  • A Master Communicator: 8-10+ years directing high-impact internal, executive, or corporate communications in agile, hyper-growth environments.

  • A High-Energy Storyteller: You write with rhythm, grit, and punch. You know how to kill jargon, synthesize complexity, and write copy that people genuinely want to read.

  • A Culture Carrier: You don’t just broadcast news; you build communities. You care deeply about trust, belonging, psychological safety, and giving employees a real voice.

  • The CEO Whisperer: You have a proven track record partnering with top executives, capturing their authentic tone, and translating vision into everyday momentum.

  • A Scale-Up Operator: Ambiguity doesn’t scare you; it energizes you. You thrive when balancing 30,000-foot strategic vision with rolling up your sleeves to hit “send.”

  • Tech-Curious & Forward-Thinking: You’re already playing with generative AI, exploring novel comms channels, and asking, "How can we do this faster, smarter, and cooler?"

  • Consumer or Purpose-Driven DNA: Experience infusing consumer-grade engagement or purpose-led storytelling into internal audiences is a huge plus (fintech background is not required; bring your fresh perspective!).

  • Based in London: Ready to collaborate on-site and bring the buzz to our London hub.

Our Fantastic Benefits (varies by location)

🌴 20 to 30 days of holiday to support a healthy work-life balance

🥳 Monthly team outing allowance to enjoy social events with your colleagues

👶 Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents

☕ On-site perks to make your workday smoother

💚 Well being support our health allowance covers gym memberships, massages, and much more to help you feel your best

PLUS additional benefits designed to enhance your work-life experience!

Shape Your Role and Make an Impact

Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change, and continuously embrace new challenges. We’re looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation.

If your skills and experience align with this role, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now and submit your CV in English.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Commercial Counsel with substantial experience in consumer-facing technology businesses to join our global Legal & Corporate Affairs team at an exciting period in Trustly's growth. You will be responsible for partnering with our commercial teams to draft, negotiate, and close a wide variety of transactions across the EU and UK. This role will work cross-functionally with product, go-to-market, consumer partnerships, compliance, and operations teams at Trustly to support the sustainable growth of a hyper-scale business across the EU and UK. You will manage multiple simultaneous complex negotiations, requiring the ability to prioritise effectively and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.

You will be a highly commercial and pragmatic individual who thrives on closing deals and enjoys partnering closely with business teams, to speak with "one voice" to external counterparties whilst launching and scaling products and services. You will possess strong experience working from counterparty's terms and templates, with strong commercial judgment and the ability to efficiently negotiate and close deals whilst protecting Trustly's interests. You will be comfortable pushing back strongly on firm redlines when required - including with internal stakeholders - whilst remaining creative and solutions-oriented when finding paths forward through complex negotiations. You will take pride in being proactive, extremely responsive to the business teams, protecting the business, and enabling innovation through creative legal solutions.

 
 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of large, complex commercial agreements with merchants, partners, and financial institutions, including payment processing agreements, merchant services agreements, API agreement, IP licences, data processing agreements, procurement agreements, and third-party provider (TPP) relationships.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate consumer terms and conditions, privacy policies, and other consumer-facing legal documentation in compliance with EU and UK consumer protection regulations.

  • Demonstrate strong expertise in working from counterparty's terms and templates, efficiently identifying and negotiating key commercial and legal issues to close deals quickly whilst protecting Trustly's interests.

  • Proactively manage and lead negotiations and build strong alliances with our commercial team in order to do so, managing multiple high-priority negotiations simultaneously with a focus on getting deals across the line.

  • Partner closely with the Sales team to ensure alignment on negotiation strategy and present a unified voice to external parties, whilst maintaining appropriate independence to push back on Trustly's firm redlines when necessary.

  • Quickly understand Trustly's payment products, technology platform, and integration methods to provide informed, practical legal advice that accounts for technical realities and business objectives.

  • Advise product, marketing, and business teams on consumer protection requirements, marketing and advertising regulations, and regulatory compliance for consumer-facing initiatives, reviewing and approving consumer communications and marketing materials.

  • Partner with Privacy and Compliance teams to ensure consumer-facing products and services meet data protection and privacy requirements, including consent management, transparency obligations, and data subject rights.

  • Develop and maintain Trustly's standard form agreements, playbooks, and contracting processes to streamline efficiency, maintain compliance, and mitigate risk.

  • Support the launch of new consumer-focused product initiatives in partnership with Product Counsel, coordinating with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure commercial agreements comply with applicable laws and regulations.

  • Provide strategic legal advice on contract interpretation and dispute resolution.

 
 

WHO YOU ARE

  • Law degree (LLB, LLM, or equivalent) and qualified solicitor, barrister, avocat, or equivalent legal qualification in the UK or another EU member state, with experience at a consumer-facing technology business (strong private practice background is required).

  • Strong technical aptitude to quickly understand complex technology products and payment systems, with a proven track record of successfully partnering with Sales and business teams.

  • Comfortable and confident pushing back strongly on firm legal and commercial redlines, including with internal teams, whilst maintaining collaborative relationships and demonstrating creativity and resourcefulness in finding solutions to complex negotiation roadblocks.

  • Proactive, highly responsive, and service-oriented approach to supporting business teams, with genuine enjoyment of closing deals and getting transactions across the line, demonstrating a results-driven mindset and entrepreneurial nature with a bias for action.

  • Experience drafting and negotiating large commercial contracts, consumer terms and conditions, privacy policies, and other legal documentation for digital products and services. Experience in FinTech, payments, or financial services strongly preferred. Experience in gaming is a plus.

  • Knowledge of marketing and advertising regulations, distance selling regulations, and e-commerce requirements.

  • Strong ability to balance regulatory compliance and consumer protection with business objectives, with excellent written and verbal communication skills to explain complex legal issues in simple terms.

  • Experience managing consumer complaints, disputes, or regulatory inquiries, and familiarity with consumer product compliance across multiple EU jurisdictions is desirable

  • Fluency in French highly desirable.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

At Trustly, you will have the chance to solve meaningful challenges alongside some of the brightest minds in FinTech. Together, we are shaping the future of payments in an environment that celebrates curiosity, collaboration, and innovation. You will be challenged and empowered to grow, making a real impact every step of the way.

Our team is as diverse as the global footprint we serve. At Trustly, we foster a workplace where everyone feels they belong—a place where teamwork thrives, ideas flourish, and we never forget to have fun along the way. We are proud and committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and believe an open and inclusive environment enables people to do their best work.

Our Fantastic Benefits (varies by location)

🌴 20 to 30 days of holiday to support a healthy work-life balance

🥳 Monthly team outing allowance to enjoy social events with your colleagues

👶 Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents

☕ On-site perks to make your workday smoother

💚 Well being support our health allowance covers gym memberships, massages, and much more to help you feel your best

PLUS additional benefits designed to enhance your work-life experience!

Shape Your Role and Make an Impact

Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change, and continuously embrace new challenges. We’re looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation.

Principal Transformation Consultant
raw.description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys is a global leader in consulting and services for the Atlassian ecosystem, helping businesses transform their IT operations and business processes. With a focus on driving operational excellence, innovation, and agility, we empower organizations to achieve their goals through tailored solutions for Atlassian tools and adjacent technologies. 
Joining Valiantys means becoming part of a growing company driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and respect for individuals, where every contribution helps shape the digital future of businesses.

 

 

Job summary

As a Principal Transformation Consultant, you will be responsible for managing key client relationships, ensuring the successful delivery of consulting engagements, and driving business growth. You will act as a strategic partner to senior client stakeholders, helping them navigate complex transformation initiatives, including large-scale cloud migrations and technology modernisation programmes, while expanding the firm’s footprint within the accounts you manage.

A core aspect of the role is consultative-led selling: identifying client needs through deep discovery, shaping compelling value propositions, and converting those into tangible engagements. You will blend strategic advisory with commercial acumen, playing a leading role in both winning and delivering transformation work. You will report to the Transformation Consulting Director

Things you will be working on

Client partnership & engagement delivery

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for client stakeholders across transformation initiatives, building trusted advisor relationships at C-level and programme director level.
  • Understand clients’ business goals, technology landscape, and transformation drivers, aligning solutions based on the Atlassian stack and related technologies.
  • Lead and support delivery teams to ensure smooth execution, quality outcomes, and client satisfaction across complex, multi-workstream programmes.
  • Contribute to the coordination and success of transformation projects—including cloud migrations, platform consolidation, and enterprise toolchain modernisation—focusing on measurable business value.

    • Technology & Transformation

  • Bring experience of enterprise technology environments, with a strong understanding of cloud platforms, migration methodologies, and the technical and organisational challenges of moving from on-premise to cloud at scale.
  • Guide clients through migration readiness assessments, architecture considerations, and transition planning for digital platforms.
  • Stay current with evolving Atlassian capabilities, cloud-native tooling, and wider enterprise technology trends to ensure our advisory is credible, differentiated, and forward-looking.
  • Bridge the gap between technical delivery teams and business stakeholders, translating complex technology decisions into clear strategic narratives.
  • Knowledge of AI solutions and use cases.

    • Consultative-Led Selling & Business Development

  • Lead consultative selling efforts: conduct structured discovery with clients, identify pain points and opportunities, and shape proposals that connect directly to business outcomes.
  • Own and drive account growth strategies for assigned accounts, identifying upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities through ongoing client engagement.
  • Collaborate closely with the sales team using MEDDPICC-aligned qualification to progress opportunities from identification through to close.
  • Develop compelling Statements of Work, business cases, and go-to-market assets that position Valiantys’s transformation capabilities clearly and credibly.
  • Support strategic planning and proposal efforts, contributing commercial and technical insight to pricing, scoping, and risk assessment.

    • Solution Design & Value Creation

  • Co-develop transformation offerings in collaboration with internal practices (e.g. AI, Cloud, ITSM, Agile at Scale).
  • Translate business and IT requirements into clear value propositions, project scopes, and transformation roadmaps.
  • Contribute to building reusable approaches, templates, and frameworks (e.g. for ITSM transformation, AI, cloud migration, PPPM maturity) that codify Valiantys’s methodology.

    • Team Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Act as a mentor and sparring partner for consultants at all levels, contributing to knowledge growth, capability development, and team performance.
  • Share market intelligence, client insights, and delivery learnings internally to enhance offering development and delivery practices.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement, professional rigour, and client-centricity across the UKI consulting team.

    • Do you have what it takes to be a Transformation Principal?

    Essential Experience & Skills

  • A minimum of 10 years’ experience in consulting, professional services, or transformation delivery roles, with significant exposure to business and IT transformation programmes.
  • Proven experience leading or playing a senior role in enterprise cloud migration or technology modernisation initiatives.
  • Demonstrable track record in consultative selling, shaping opportunities through discovery, building client business cases, and converting advisory engagements into revenue.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise technology landscapes, including cloud platforms (Atlassian Cloud, AWS), DevOps toolchains, and ITSM/PPPM disciplines.
  • Proven ability to build and sustain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders (Director, VP, C-level) and to influence decision-making at that level.
  • Experience managing and growing client accounts with a clear contribution to revenue targets.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, comfortable leading workshops, steering committees, and executive briefings.
  • Adaptable and proactive, thriving in dynamic environments where you balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving.

    • Desirable

  • Experience working within or alongside the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management) or comparable enterprise platforms.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or similar structured sales qualification methodologies.
  • Experience with Agile at Scale frameworks (SAFe, LeSS, or bespoke) and their application in large enterprise settings.
  • Exposure to managed services or Total Care-style ongoing client engagements.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Atlassian, ITIL, PMP, SAFe, cloud platform certifications).
  • Ability to shape Valiantys AI Strategy based on actual Customer Outcomes and Use Cases.
    • Location & Working Arrangements

    This role is based in the United Kingdom. We are opened to remote working across the UK with regular travel to client sites and the London office as required.

    Some travel within the wider EMEA region may be expected.


    Why Join Valiantys?
    Join a fast-growing, innovation-driven organization where transformation is at the heart of everything we do. As part of our team, you’ll help shape the future of Developer Experience transformation by working with global enterprises to optimize software delivery. You'll collaborate closely with top-tier experts in IT consulting, business transformation, and DevEx, all within a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment that values impact, creativity, and continuous improvement.

    Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to personal background, identity, or beliefs.

Product Marketing Lead
raw.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking an experienced Product Marketing Lead to own how the world understands our products and ecosystem. They will work closely with the product teams to frame product positioning, commercial narratives, and GTM strategies across our agentic platform, AI Materials Foundry and new products as they emerge.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the product marketing function that transforms CuspAI's deep scientific breakthroughs into clear, credible narratives, accelerating our GTM engine and scaling the global impact of our AI Materials Foundry.

Over time, you will scale the function by hiring, coaching, and leading a high-performing product marketing team.

What You Will Do

Platform Launch & Go-to-Market

  • Lead the end-to-end launch of science products, from early-access and design-partner programmes through announcement and general availability.

  • Plan and execute GTM for subsequent releases, new modules, scientific milestones, and strategic ecosystem announcements, building a repeatable launch process.

  • Work with Product, Commercial and Finance on pricing and packaging.

  • Build the product marketing for self-serve adoption, including website product pages, onboarding content and in-product messaging that turn early users into paying customers.

  • Partner with Comms/PR on press and analyst narratives, Partnerships on co-marketing campaigns, and Creative teams on high-impact visual assets.

  • Co-own narrative alignment and onboarding sessions for new Foundry participants.

Product Positioning & Messaging Architecture

  • Own the messaging and naming architecture for new products, the AI Materials Foundry, and emerging product capabilities, working with leadership and Brand as the platform expands through regular releases.

  • Build segment- and persona-level messaging tailored to the experimental scientists who use the platform day to day, the technical buyers who sign off on it (e.g. CTOs and Heads of R&D), and Foundry partners (e.g. industrial customers, compute partners, and research labs).

  • Collaborate with AI Researchers, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure all performance claims are scientifically defensible and reflect current platform capabilities.

  • Own competitive positioning against general-purpose AI science assistants and specialist materials-discovery platforms, and keep competitive intelligence current for Commercial, Product and the Founders.

Foundry & Partner Ecosystem Marketing

  • Define and articulate the Foundry membership proposition, framing how network effects compound scientific discovery over time.

  • Drive co-marketing programs with founding and future partners (e.g. joint case studies, event presence, and co-authored thought leadership).

  • Develop recurring quantitative proof points that demonstrate real-world validation outcomes and accelerated R&D timelines.

Sales Enablement & Customer Intelligence

  • Equip Commercial and Partnerships teams with pitch decks, one-pagers, and demo scripts.

  • Build customer case studies and reference stories in multiple formats.

Must Have Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in product marketing within deep tech, scientific software, enterprise AI/ML platforms, semiconductors, or advanced industrial sectors.

  • Proven track record of building product positioning, messaging architectures, and GTM frameworks from scratch in high-growth environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate highly complex, deep-tech subject matter into clear, rigorous, and compelling commercial narratives without losing scientific accuracy.

  • Hands-on experience managing partner, ecosystem, or multi-sided platform marketing programs.

  • Strong collaborative skills with experience working cross-functionally alongside scientific researchers, product managers, commercial leaders, and design teams.

  • High autonomy and leadership aptitude, with a strong desire to transition from an individual contributor to building and managing a team as the company scales.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Academic background (BSc, MSc, or PhD) in Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.

  • Direct experience marketing to buyers within semiconductors, chemicals, clean energy, or advanced manufacturing sectors.

  • Prior experience navigating scale-up dynamics in a fast-growing, post-Series B technology company.

  • Familiarity with agentic AI workflows, atomistic simulation tools, or scientific machine learning frameworks.

Additional Considerations

This role is ideally based in our London office (we would also consider Cambridge, Amsterdam or Berlin), with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

raw.description:
About the Role

As Senior Product Manager, you'll be responsible for defining the vision, strategy and roadmap for a new strategic area of Fynapse; ensuring we continue to solve the right customer problems while supporting the long-term evolution of the platform.


Working closely with Engineering, Product Design, Finance Subject Matter Experts and customers, you'll lead product discovery, shape investments and deliver meaningful outcomes. You'll also play an important role in strengthening product management practices across the team, helping to coach and support fellow Product Managers.


This role is ideal for a Product Manager who enjoys owning complex platform capabilities and can bring strong product leadership to a highly specialised domain. While accounting experience is beneficial, we're looking first and foremost for someone with excellent product management skills who can navigate complexity, influence stakeholders and drive outcomes.

You will be expected to provide leadership within the Product function, mentoring Product Managers and helping raise the quality of product practices across the organisation.

What you'll do

Product strategy and vision

  • Define and evolve the vision, strategy and roadmap for a new strategic area

  • Identify opportunities to expand and mature capabilities in support of future platform growth.

  • Align product investments and shape the long-term direction of the domain, balancing customer outcomes, technical sustainability and commercial priorities.

Discovery and product development

  • Lead discovery activities to understand customer needs, validate opportunities and reduce delivery risk.

  • Translate complex business and accounting requirements into intuitive product solutions.

  • Use customer insight, data and research to inform product decisions and prioritisation.

Delivery and collaboration

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Go to Market teams and Product Design to deliver high-quality outcomes.

  • Manage dependencies and trade-offs across teams, stakeholders and product domains.

  • Build strong relationships with customers, partners and subject matter experts to ensure we are solving the right problems.

Leadership and product excellence

  • Champion strong product management practices across the organisation.

  • Coach and support Product Managers, helping to raise product capability within the team.

  • Bring structure, clarity and direction to complex problems and ambiguous situations.

  • Influence decision-making through effective stakeholder engagement and evidence-based thinking.

 

Why join us?

  • Own and shape one of the most strategically important domains within the Fynapse platform.

  • Solve complex customer and business challenges with real-world impact.

  • Help define the next generation of accounting capabilities that will support the future growth of the platform.

  • Influence the future direction of a growing enterprise product.

  • Work alongside experienced product, design, engineering and finance specialists.

  • Help raise the standard of product management across the organisation.


What you'll bring

  • Experience managing and evolving complex B2B SaaS products.

  • Strong product discovery, prioritisation and roadmap management skills.

  • Experience working closely with teams on technical, functional or platform-focused products.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.

  • Experience managing, mentoring or supporting other Product Managers.

  • A track record of delivering meaningful customer and business outcomes.

raw.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Head of Product Operations (m/f/d) to join our Product team in Munich, Madrid, London or Paris with a hybrid work setup. In this role, you will lead and improve the operations that are directly linked to our products. Your work will directly impact our operational integrity notably by enhancing fraud detection, streamlining customer support processes, or managing cash projections. All of which are critical to delivering a trustworthy and seamless experience for our users.

This dedicated product operations position was triggered by the launch of new offer types within our product, and the scope of the role will expand as we innovate with our product. 

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Drive end-to-end fraud management and detection strategies across all product types and payment flows.
  • Streamline customer support workflows to improve resolution speed, operational efficiency, and user trust.
  • Oversee the operational maintenance and reliability of coupon auto-apply and app-to-app features.
  • Partner with Finance to forecast and manage cash allocations and liquidity across provider accounts.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product and key teams to translate business needs into scalable operational solutions.
  • Champion AI and automation initiatives to generate operational insights and drive continuous process improvements.

Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with 

  • 3 - 5 years of experience in strategy consulting, mergers and acquisitions, or operations in tech
  • Strategic & Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities, with the ability to break down complex business problems, identify opportunities, and develop scalable solutions. 
  • Operational Excellence: Proven ability to design, standardize, and optimize processes across complex or rapidly evolving products and organizations.
  • Leadership & Collaboration: A strong leadership track record
  • Mindset: A proactive and persistent mindset, adaptability in a dynamic environment, and a strong interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve operational efficiency and decision-making.
  • Language requirements: Fluent in English and any other European languages is a plus.

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

#LI-PZ

#LI-Hybrid

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. 

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.
Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

We are seeking an exceptionally organized, tech-forward Talent Operations Associate to join our Global Talent Acquisition team. As our Talent Operations Associate in London, you will bridge the gap between ensuring our recruiters, and interviewer community are able to find the best talent, through cutting-edge Talent Operations.

We are seeking a proactive AI and automation expert to transform our hiring operations. In this role, you will leverage emerging tools to streamline scheduling, resolve logistics challenges, and build data-driven dashboards. If you thrive on solving complex problems, engaging consultatively with senior stakeholders, and redefining talent operations, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data reporting: handle regional and departmental data reporting, and produce reports and dashboards for the talent acquisition team

  • AI, automation & workflow optimisation: use AI tools and automation to remove manual bottlenecks, hunt for friction points in daily operations, and redesign workflows toward an admin-zero environment.

  • TA Ops projects:Work on a range of strategic projects as needed for example interviewer training, implementing new tooling or designing refined TA processes.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Data quality: perform regular data-quality checks to keep reporting accurate and reliable.

  • Ashby / ATS ownership: own and configure Ashby within agreed standards and controls, testing new features and AI integrations to improve pipeline velocity.

  • Contract configuration: configure the contracts for your region and update them as Legal and the People team make changes in Ashby, and build addendums (e.g. start date) that can live in Ashby.

  • Support the recruiters in your region with Ashby and workflow optimisation: optimise interview plans, set up automations, make sure comms are correct, and unblock recruiter issues as they arise.

  • Process documentation: write SOPs and policies for TA and keep the knowledge base up to date as things move forward.

Required Qualifications

You’re a curious, analytical and motivated individual either due to graduate in summer 2027 or having graduated within the last 24 months, who is excited to dive into the world of Talent Operations.

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree a related field, or relevant work experience in these fields.

  • Curious Problem-Solving: You enjoy learning about issues, asking questions and doing research to find solutions to complex problems.

  • AI & Automation Proficiency: A demonstrated passion for using AI tools, prompt engineering, or workflow automations

  • Data Fluency: Demonstrated ability to work with data and build reporting dashboards to guide decisions.

  • Executive Presence: Confident, tactful communication skills with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and hold them accountable to timeline commitments.

  • Project Management: Ability to prioritize, organize and manage multiple projects in various stages with ease.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

We are seeking an exceptionally organized, tech-forward Talent Operations Associate to join our Global Talent Acquisition team. As our Talent Operations Associate in London, you will bridge the gap between ensuring our recruiters, and interviewer community are able to find the best talent, through cutting-edge Talent Operations.

We are seeking a proactive AI and automation expert to transform our hiring operations. In this role, you will leverage emerging tools to streamline scheduling, resolve logistics challenges, and build data-driven dashboards. If you thrive on solving complex problems, engaging consultatively with senior stakeholders, and redefining talent operations, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data reporting: handle regional and departmental data reporting, and produce reports and dashboards for the talent acquisition team

  • AI, automation & workflow optimisation: use AI tools and automation to remove manual bottlenecks, hunt for friction points in daily operations, and redesign workflows toward an admin-zero environment.

  • TA Ops projects:Work on a range of strategic projects as needed for example interviewer training, implementing new tooling or designing refined TA processes.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Data quality: perform regular data-quality checks to keep reporting accurate and reliable.

  • Ashby / ATS ownership: own and configure Ashby within agreed standards and controls, testing new features and AI integrations to improve pipeline velocity.

  • Contract configuration: configure the contracts for your region and update them as Legal and the People team make changes in Ashby, and build addendums (e.g. start date) that can live in Ashby.

  • Support the recruiters in your region with Ashby and workflow optimisation: optimise interview plans, set up automations, make sure comms are correct, and unblock recruiter issues as they arise.

  • Process documentation: write SOPs and policies for TA and keep the knowledge base up to date as things move forward.

Required Qualifications

You’re a curious, analytical and motivated individual either due to graduate in summer 2027 or having graduated within the last 24 months, who is excited to dive into the world of Talent Operations.

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree a related field, or relevant work experience in these fields.

  • Curious Problem-Solving: You enjoy learning about issues, asking questions and doing research to find solutions to complex problems.

  • AI & Automation Proficiency: A demonstrated passion for using AI tools, prompt engineering, or workflow automations

  • Data Fluency: Demonstrated ability to work with data and build reporting dashboards to guide decisions.

  • Executive Presence: Confident, tactful communication skills with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and hold them accountable to timeline commitments.

  • Project Management: Ability to prioritize, organize and manage multiple projects in various stages with ease.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

Company Description

This role is part of the Revenue and Billing Operations Team, reporting to the Senior Manager Revenue and Billing Operations.

The purpose of this team is to accurately account for revenue, cost of sales and the associated balance sheet amounts, to ensure there are robust controls over processes and the balance sheet, and to provide analysis on Checkout’s net revenue results.

What you'll be doing:

  • Preparing balance sheet reconciliations for different balance sheet accounts , posting manual correction journals and working with different teams to resolve balance sheet issues.

  • Effectively business partner Finance leadership , providing commentary and analysis on Net revenue performance and balance sheet position.

  • Support the group audit for the revenue and billing operations team.

  • Hold responsibility for setting up new revenue and balance sheet recording processes, including writing procedure manuals and providing guidance to more junior members of staff.

  • Continuous improvement of reporting/ processes to assist with stakeholder requirements.

  • Set-up documentation and processes that are robust and well controlled for period end close and audit purposes.

  • Continually look at ways of improving data integrity and quality, automation, strengthening of controls, operational and reporting efficiency.

  • Perform accounting and reconciliation processes and controls across our key trading account balances.

  • Analyse and reconcile data from various systems and sources to identify control gaps and reconciliation breaks.

  • Participate in ad hoc projects as required.

Qualifications

  • Professional finance qualification such as ACCA/ CIMA or equivalent

  • Preferably with at least six years of progressive finance experience including month end reporting activities, and at least three years’ experience of balance sheet reconciliations

  • Proven ability to find end-to-end solutions to issues and work cross-functionally and with remote teams - including Finance, Product, Engineering, Data.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with ability to communicate with all levels.

  • Experience of revenue month end and ASC606/ IFRS 15.

  • Strong data analysis , excel data modelling and exposure to A.I automation tools.

  • Experienced in working in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment

  • Experienced with ERP systems (Workday Financials preferred but not required)

  • Experience of working in a high-volume, complex and dynamic environment in a complex, regulatory environment, ideally within Payments/FinTech or Financial Services

Additional Information

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

We are excited to be growing our incredible London Legal team and are looking to hire 2 Legal Counsel with a strong regulatory background in financial services.

As Legal Counsel, you will work closely with all areas of the business and take a collaborative approach to solving complex legal challenges. You will be expected to advise on compliance with financial services and payments regulations, interact with regulators and assist in the implementation of broader regulatory projects and product launches across the Checkout.com group.

The successful candidate will be able to handle a busy workload with minimal supervision, demonstrating excellent critical judgment, quick thinking and agility. This is a great opportunity to work on a broad range of projects across multiple jurisdictions, learn new areas of law and play a key role in supporting the company’s rapid growth.

You will be joining an expanding team in one of Europe's most valuable fintechs. Our mission is to be a legal team that exceeds expectations across the board, providing pragmatic and commercially focused advice, finding creative solutions to manage risk and becoming trusted advisers to our colleagues in the business.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • This role is based in London at our global head office and sits within the regulatory vertical of our Legal department

  • Support relationships with regulators on license-related matters, including potential de novo applications

  • Review payments product structures, flows and terms to ensure compliance with legal requirements

  • Advise on payments regulatory matters, including compliance with payments laws and related regulations across our different jurisdictions

  • Advise on broader regulatory requirements applicable to payment services providers, including with respect to group regulatory change projects

  • Advise the business on market expansion, researching and evaluating new territories and applying for new licenses or expanding the scope of existing licenses

  • Advise key business functions on new regulatory developments impacting our operations, products and contractual commitments

  • Conduct research on various multi-jurisdictional legal issues

  • Support the company’s strategic projects and initiatives by providing creative, proactive and results-orientated advice

What We Are Looking For

  • Qualified solicitor/lawyer (3-7 PQE) with strong post-qualification experience either in-house or in private practice

  • Strong understanding of legal principles applicable to payments in the UK, including the payments ecosystem and payments regulatory and licensing strategy/execution, and to broader financial institutions

  • Previous FinTech, payments, software, e-commerce and/or bank experience is desirable but not essential

  • Experience working in a start up or other fast-paced and dynamic environment is desirable but not essential

  • Comfort with ambiguity, constant change, and a fast-paced culture

  • A practical, solutions-oriented focus to solving legal challenges

  • Experience working internationally and on a variety of cross-border matters

  • Excellent time management skills and experience managing a diverse workload and competing stakeholder demands

  • Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively as needed, flexing the approach as the matter requires

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate and explain complex legal issues clearly and concisely

  • Enthusiasm for new challenges and skilling up in different areas of law

Additional Information

raw.description:
Company Description

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.
