With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a skilled, tech-savvy Legal Operations Specialist to join our fast-paced legal team. As a core member of the department within a leading payment processing company, you will help drive operational excellence, scale our legal tech stack, and streamline workflows.

The ideal candidate helps bridge the gap between legal expertise, technology, and data-driven efficiency. You will be responsible for managing our complex contract ecosystems, optimising team collaboration tools, and leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) to design modern, automated legal processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Legal Tech Stack & Automation Strategy: Support the administration, integration, and continuous improvement of our legal technology tools, with a heavy emphasis on Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) systems.

  • Atlassian Ecosystem: Support the legal department's Jira infrastructure. This includes assisting with the design, maintenance, and optimisation of workflows in Jira Service Management (JSM) for legal intake, helping manage Jira Spaces, and building out a comprehensive, user-friendly knowledge base in Confluence.

  • AI & Process Engineering: Proactively identify opportunities to embed AI and machine learning tools into everyday legal operations, supporting the development and implementation of AI-driven efficiencies (e.g., automated contract review, AI search optimisation, legal operations chatbots, and automated triaging) to help reduce cycle times.

  • Workflow Optimisation: Evaluate existing legal processes, identify bottlenecks in the payment processing legal pipeline (e.g., merchant agreements, vendor contracts, regulatory tracking), and engineer streamlined, scalable workflows.

  • Data Analytics & Reporting: Design dashboards and generate metrics within Jira and CLM tools to track legal spend, turnaround times, contract volumes, and team capacity. Present actionable insights to legal leadership.

  • Vendor & Resource Support: Help manage relationships with legal tech vendors (e.g. Brightflag) and ensure the team is maximising the value of industry resources (e.g., CLOC, ACC).

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in Legal Operations, ideally within a fintech, payment processing, or highly regulated corporate environment.

  • Experience working with enterprise CLM systems (e.g., Ironclad, LinkSquares, Icertis, or Conga), including template building and workflow routing.

  • Good working knowledge of Jira, specifically designing custom workflows, queues, and SLAs in JSM, helping manage Jira Spaces, and structuring documentation in Confluence.

  • Experience using generative AI tools, prompt engineering, or AI-backed legal tech features to build efficiencies, automate repetitive tasks, and analyse legal data.

  • General understanding of the legal operational challenges unique to payment processing, financial services, or tech companies.

Preferred Skills & Core Competencies

  • Tech-Forward Mindset: Instead of simply using tools, look for ways to make them talk to each other. Experience with integrations (APIs, Zapier) is a massive plus.

  • Problem-Solving & Agility: Ability to thrive in a high-volume, rapidly changing corporate environment.

  • Project Management: Strong organisational skills with a proven ability to manage and support multiple tech implementation projects simultaneously (PRINCE2 qualification a plus, but not necessary).

  • Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical or legal requirements into clear, user-friendly processes for cross-functional stakeholders such as Product, Sales and Compliance.

Additional Information

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Every payment we process runs on infrastructure we built. At Checkout.com, the Cloud Platform team owns the cloud foundations that global payments depend on: a large multi-account AWS estate, a growing Azure platform, and the networking and connectivity that reaches card schemes and banks worldwide. We are genuinely multi-cloud, and we are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer who is too - a strong generalist who treats infrastructure as a software problem and can deliver from week one.

This is a hands-on senior role in an established, fast-moving team. Everything we run is defined in code, deployed through pipelines, and reviewed like software. You will bring deep cloud expertise across AWS and Azure and pair it with a genuine software engineering mindset: you write Terraform modules others build on, you automate away toil rather than documenting it, and you treat the platform as a product with users, SLOs, and a roadmap.

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you are responsible for the technical delivery of your team's services. You will work closely with your Engineering Manager to shape direction, manage dependencies across pillars, and ensure our platform meets the standards a regulated payments business demands.

What we are looking for:

Deep AWS expertise: Advanced, hands-on experience designing and operating production infrastructure in AWS at enterprise scale: multi-account architectures (Control Tower, Organizations, SCPs), IAM, KMS, and the core compute, storage, and security services that a large regulated estate runs on. You should have a proven track record of delivering resilient, multi-region architectures.

Azure experience: Real production experience with Azure alongside AWS: landing zones, VNet architectures, Entra ID, and the Azure resource and governance model. You understand where the two clouds differ and can design well for both rather than forcing one cloud's patterns onto the other.

Software engineering mindset: You treat infrastructure as software. Expert-level Terraform: reusable modules, secure state management, and disciplined code review. You are comfortable in a Git-based workflow with CI/CD (we use Spacelift), and you reach for Python or similar to automate what others would handle with a runbook. No ClickOps.

Strong cloud networking: Confident designing and debugging in a complex network estate: VPC and VNet design, hub-and-spoke and Transit Gateway or Cloud WAN architectures, DNS, private connectivity (PrivateLink, Private Link), and enough routing knowledge to own connectivity issues end to end rather than escalate them.

Kubernetes: Solid experience running containerised workloads in production, ideally on EKS/AKS: cluster lifecycle, workload deployment patterns, and the operational realities of keeping Kubernetes healthy at scale.

Security and compliance awareness: Experience operating in regulated environments. You understand why change control, least privilege, and auditability matter, and you design controls in rather than bolting them on. Familiarity with PCI DSS is a strong plus.

Engineering excellence: A focus on observability and measurement: you instrument what you build and answer operational questions with data rather than opinion.

Leadership and mentorship: A natural ability to guide and mentor peers, translate ambiguous problem definitions into actionable technical plans, and raise the bar through your code and your reviews.

Pragmatic problem solver: You understand when to move fast (creating tech debt) and when to move right (paying it off). You are a cornerstone in incident resolution and root-cause analysis.

Experience: 5+ years in cloud engineering roles with significant AWS depth. We need someone who can hit the ground running: comfortable joining a complex, established estate and delivering meaningful work in their first weeks, not their first quarter. A degree in Computer Science or a related field is useful but not required; we care about what you can build.

How you’ll make an impact:

Lead Design & Delivery: Take ownership of large-scale platform projects end to end, from architecture through Terraform to production, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and cost-optimised.

Build the paved road: Design the platform primitives that every product team at Checkout.com builds on, so that the secure path is also the easy path.

Architectural Influence: Work with Engineering Managers and architects to refine requirements and shape the technical direction of the platform, documenting significant decisions as ADRs.

Operational SME: Act as the Subject Matter Expert for numerous team-owned services, providing advanced operational support and ensuring high availability for our global payment systems.

Evangelise Best Practices: Produce exemplary code and documentation that inspires others. You will be responsible for spreading best practices and standards across your group.

Manage Dependencies: Navigate the organisation to manage technical dependencies inside and outside your pillar, optimising for both delivery speed and business outcomes.

Foster Culture: Embody Checkout Operating Principles, using them to shape the group’s culture and acting as an example of efficiency and professional excellence.

AI Integration: Proactively explore and implement AI-driven automation to enhance infrastructure efficiency and team productivity.

Checkout.com is scaling a multi-cloud environment at pace, and security architecture is central to how we do it safely.

As Senior Cloud Security Engineer, you'll work closely with Engineering, GRC, Technology Risk, and Security Operations to embed security into every design decision and to make sure we can see what's happening across the estate once it's live.

You'll help embed security within the design phase and ongoing operations of our multi-cloud posture, define guardrails and policy-as-code standards, and support the strengthening of our SIEM and detection capability. You'll take on the most complex and ambiguous cloud security challenges in the business, and hold engineers to best practices.

This isn't a tool-monitoring role. You're here to lead security-by-design, set best-practice standards, and raise the bar.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Develop and enforce reference security architectures, patterns, and blueprints for secure cloud adoption across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

  • Conduct security assessments for new cloud services, defining preventative and detective controls (via security guardrails) to maintain secure posture and detect drift.

  • Partner with Engineering teams to embed security guardrails early in design, ensuring compliance and resilience without adding friction.

  • Evaluate engineering and platform architecture proposals, identifying security gaps and seeing remediation through to completion.

  • Document and uphold secure-by-design principles and architecture governance, and enforce policy-as-code frameworks aligned with NIST, CIS, and PCI DSS.

  • Set the monitoring scope and priorities for CNAPP/CSPM tooling (e.g. Wiz or equivalent), defining which misconfigurations and vulnerabilities matter most against CIS, NIST, and PCI DSS benchmarks, and holding engineering teams accountable to remediation outcomes.

  • Work with Security Operations to shape cloud logging and detection requirements, ensuring our SIEM has the right visibility across the estate.

  • Collaborate with senior stakeholders to articulate security risks and mitigations in terms that support business decision-making.

Skills and Experience We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with strong technical expertise and a genuine passion for security. Here's what we need:

  • Risk-based decision-making and adherence to regulatory and internal security standards (PCI DSS, NIST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, CIS).

  • Broad knowledge across security domains and their capabilities within AWS, Azure, and GCP, with 6+ years' hands-on experience and SME depth in at least one platform.

  • Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), API security, and IaC security (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates).

  • Securing user and non-user access at scale, including Azure Policy and cloud-native IAM controls.

  • Demonstrated ability to provide clear, security-focused guidance, combined with excellent communication and senior-stakeholder engagement skills, and experience mentoring other engineers.

Nice to Have

  • CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent certifications.

  • AZ-500, AWS Certified Security, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or equivalent cloud security certification.

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.

  • Experience integrating ATT&CK Navigator into SOC workflows.

Job Description

About the role

Checkout.com is looking for an ambitious Staff Data Engineer to join our Data and AI Platform Team. Our team’s mission is to build a platform where you can create reliable, scalable, AI-powered streaming and batch data applications, and share data across Checkout.com to improve business performance.


The Data and AI Platform team is here to ensure internal stakeholders can easily collect, store, process and utilise data to build AI use cases and data products aiming to solve business problems. Our focus is on maximising the amount of time engineers spend on solving business problems and minimising time spent on technical details around implementation, deployment, and monitoring of their solutions.

We're building for scale. As such, much of what we design and implement today is the technology/infrastructure which will serve hundreds of teams and petabyte-level volumes of data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with stream processing technologies (Kafka and Flink) to build a continuously available large-scale event streaming platform

  • Leverage subject matter and technical expertise to provide leadership, mentoring, and strategic influence across the organisation whilst building strong relationships with engineers and engineering managers

  • Build tooling (modules/SDKs/DSLs) and associated documentation to foster the adoption of the streaming platform by enabling upstream teams and systems to easily publish data and deploy streaming applications

  • Implement all the necessary infrastructure to enable end users to build, host, monitor and deploy their own streaming applications

  • Provide consultancy across the technology organisation to drive the adoption of the platform and unlock event-driven use-cases

  • Participate, translate, run and execute the collection of requirements and architecture/design initiatives into action plans

  • Provide hands-on support for all event-based systems including incident triage and root cause analysis


About You

While experience with our specific tech stack is a plus, we welcome candidates with a strong background in data systems who are eager to learn. The core remit of this role is to own and scale our event streaming capability, not to serve as a general DevOps or infrastructure engineer.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills with a proven track record of influencing engineering organisations

  • Strong engineering background with a track record of implementing and owning event streaming platforms

  • Hands-on experience working with stream technologies, ideally Kafka

  • Experience designing and implementing stream processing applications with Flink

  • Experience working with cloud-based technologies such as AWS (MSK, S3, Lambda, ECS, SNS)

  • Experience with Kubernetes (either self-hosted or on the cloud)

  • Experience with SQL databases

  • Experience working with Docker, container deployment and management

  • Experience describing infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) as well as designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines

  • Excellent programming skills with at least one of Java or Python

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Financial Crime Intelligence & Investigations Team as a Court Orders and Liaison Manager? Reporting to the Senior Manager, you will take ownership of the court order and law‑enforcement enquiry framework, ensuring both the day‑to‑day workload and long‑term strategic development of the function are delivered to a high standard. You will oversee the quality, accuracy and timeliness of responses while also supporting the wider team with complex, sensitive or time‑critical matters.

Working at the intersection of legal process management, intelligence and external engagement, you will help shape how ClearBank interacts with police, regulatory bodies and authorised agencies. Your role blends operational leadership with forward‑looking improvements - ensuring consistency and compliance today, while strengthening our model for the future.

You’ll thrive in a fast‑moving environment where priorities can shift quickly, providing direction through change and ensuring the team maintains high standards. You’ll support escalations, guide decision‑making and apply sound judgement underpinned by strong knowledge of payment services and financial‑crime, sanctions and disclosure obligations across the UK and other jurisdictions.

Working Hours: This role requires regular participation in an out-of-hours on-call rota, including evenings, weekends and bank holidays, to support business-critical activities and incidents.

Your role includes:

  • Overseeing the full lifecycle of court orders, ensuring the operational process runs efficiently, lawfully and to evidential standards

  • Managing the day‑to‑day handling of law‑enforcement enquiries while ensuring the team delivers timely, accurate and compliant responses

  • Acting as a senior liaison point for law‑enforcement agencies, regulators and government bodies, supporting a consistent and professional engagement model

  • Ensuring robust compliance across all disclosure activity, including adherence to AML/CTF, data‑protection legislation, POCA, TACT and relevant regulatory requirements

  • Providing guidance on complex or sensitive requests, supporting team members in applying sound judgement to risk‑based decisions

  • Leading the escalation process where enquiries or disclosures highlight unusual activity, inconsistencies or heightened financial‑crime risk

  • Reviewing and signing off internal and external reports, ensuring outputs meet evidential and regulatory standards

  • Accountable for team outcomes and responsible for complex/high risk decisions

  • Maintaining strong governance, record‑keeping and audit trails across all court‑order and enquiry activity

  • Monitoring evolving law‑enforcement practices, typologies and legislative changes to shape process improvements and team capability

  • Contributing to broader Financial Crime Intelligence initiatives, supporting risk mitigation, process optimisation and strategic development across the function

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Extensive experience managing or working with law‑enforcement enquiries, court orders, warrants or disclosure frameworks within financial services or law‑enforcement environments

  • Strong technical and regulatory knowledge across AML/CTF, financial crime risk, sanctions and relevant legislation

  • Proven ability to oversee and support complex operational processes while guiding teams through judgement‑based decisions

  • Experience with complex datasets, operational systems or investigative information flows

  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to balance legal obligations with customer protection and risk appetite

  • Strong relationship‑building skills, with experience engaging professionally with external agencies

  • A proactive, solutions‑focused mindset with the ability to manage high‑volume, time‑sensitive workflows while driving continuous improvement

  • Recognised qualifications in Law, AML, financial crime, intelligence, fraud or similar fields would be highly advantageous

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. raw.title: Head of Data (London)
raw.description:
Own Conveo's data, from the warehouse to the dashboard, and build the team every part of the business relies on.

This role can be based from either our London or Antwerp location.

Conveo is building the AI-powered infrastructure for consumer understanding, making consumer and B2B research fast, affordable and high quality. Global brands such as Unilever, Google and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across their marketing, product and research teams.

Backed by Y Combinator, we're in a period of rapid growth. We started this year with around 20 people and are on track to reach around 120 by year end, so the people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how the company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We’re investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

The Role

You'll be our first Head of Data. You'll own internal data at Conveo and build the team that serves the whole company with it.

You won't be starting from a blank page. Our GTM engineering team has built a data warehouse and semantic layer and has made a start on BI, and colleagues in operations have helped shape our metric definitions. What we don't have is one person who owns all of it, knows what good looks like, and turns it into something every team trusts and uses.

You'll report to our CFO and work very closely with our CTO, as well as with the engineering team, operations and go-to-market. This is a hands-on role. You'll be in the data yourself, not writing a strategy and handing it over. You'll start as the first member of the data team, with a remit to hire as we grow.

This is a role for the long term, not an audit-and-leave project. It starts with the foundations and grows into a bigger team, with room for machine learning and data science to help us predict more across the business.

What You'll Do

Own the data stack end to end

  • Take ownership of our warehouse (Google BigQuery), our transformation and semantic layers (dbt and Cube today) and our BI tooling (Metabase today)

  • Review what's been built with a critical eye, and get it ready to scale as new tools and data sources come in

  • Think through access rights, so it's clear who can see customer, HR and financial data once it all lives in one place

Build one source of truth the business trusts

  • Own metric definitions, so every team works from the same numbers

  • Close the gaps that matter most, starting with areas like marketing attribution and the data our finance team needs for its analysis

  • Make our data reliable enough that people trust it and act on it

Turn data into insight for every team

  • Sit down with department leads, get to the real question behind a request, and build the analysis that answers it

  • Act as the translator between engineering and the business: ask engineers the hard questions about what to build, and explain data in plain English to everyone else

  • Swap today's sprawl of one-off dashboards and AI-generated reports for a clear set of things people actually need to look at

Use AI well, without the slop

  • Shape our data so AI tools can use it reliably

  • Help the business get real value from AI for analysis, without a flood of low-quality output

Build the data team

  • Hire your first team members, and set out what the BI team should look like as we grow

  • Lay the groundwork for machine learning and data science later on

What Success Looks Like

  • After one month: you know our data infrastructure properly and have run a full gap analysis covering what we take in, what we understand and what's missing. You also have a plan for what to fix first and a plan for the team, including your first hires.

  • After three months: you've reviewed the setup in place and own BigQuery, the transformation layer and our BI tooling, and our systems are ready to scale. Teams are already using data better because of work you've delivered.

  • After six months: every department is running with deep insights and analytics, and our leaders have the confidence and ability to use the data themselves.

  • Throughout: people trust the numbers, the business has the dashboards it needs rather than a thousand it doesn't, and we know who the data team hires next.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience leading data at a startup or scale-up, as a Head of Data, Head of Analytics or similar. Ideally you've been at a Series B company or later and have seen what good structure looks like at the next stage

  • Hands-on BI and analytics experience. You've done the insights work, not only data engineering, and you know what good BI looks like

  • Enough technical depth to ask engineers the hard questions, and a clear understanding of how data flows from the warehouse through transformation and semantic layers into a BI tool.

  • A problem solver's instinct: you can talk to a department lead, draw out what they really need, and turn it into analysis

  • A commercial mindset: you understand how a business works and what it needs from its data

  • Strong stakeholder skills. Lots of people will want your time, and you prioritise well while keeping their trust

  • Everyday use of AI in how you work, and a view on how to build data that AI tools can rely on

  • Experience of the challenges that come with scaling fast, and a clear sense of the structure you'll bring as we grow

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with BigQuery, dbt, Cube or Metabase

Why join us?

  • Work directly with frontier AI models and push what they can actually do.

  • Join a YC-backed team that's growing fast and gives you room to grow with it.

  • Competitive salary (£115k-£130k) and meaningful equity. We want you to own a real piece of what we're building.

  • Offices in London, Antwerp, and New York. We work best together, so we ask for 3 days a week in the office.

  • Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more.

  • Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to. Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal.

  • Private health coverage with Vitality (incl. dental, vision)

  • Enhanced employer pension contribution (5% employer, 3% employee contribution)

  • Refer someone great and earn up to £5,000.

raw.title: People Operations Manager
raw.description:
About Conveo

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.


The Context

Conveo is scaling from $4M to $50M, and the People team is running on goodwill and late nights. We have a recruiting team and a new L&D hire joining, but nobody owns the processes and systems underneath them. Compensation schemes, performance cycles and salary reviews all land on Claudia, alongside the daily operational load.

That has to change before we grow further. You'll be the first dedicated People Operations hire, reporting to Claudia. You'll build the operating system for the whole People function: the tools, data, cycles and lifecycle processes that let us hire, pay, develop and support people well across the UK, Belgium and the US.

You'll work closely with Finance on payroll and compensation, with recruiting and L&D on the employee lifecycle, and with managers across the company. When you've done this well, Claudia spends her time on strategy and growing the team, not on firefighting.

Your Mission

1. Own the People systems stack and make it work across every country

You decide how our People tools fit together, then make them run. Today that spans an HRIS, EOR and PEO providers, and payroll across several geographies.

  • Own the HRIS as the single source of truth for every employee, contractor and EOR hire

  • Lead a possible payroll migration end to end: vendor choice, data cleanup, parallel runs, cutover

  • Manage EOR and PEO relationships across the UK, Belgium and the US

  • Connect systems so data flows once, not through spreadsheets and copy-paste

  • Use AI and automation to remove manual admin wherever it adds no judgement

2. Build an employee lifecycle that feels effortless at 2x our size

Every hire, move and exit should follow a clear, repeatable path that works in any country we operate in.

  • Design onboarding, internal moves and offboarding flows with recruiting and L&D

  • Turn tribal knowledge into documented processes and self-serve answers

  • Keep contracts, documents and policies consistent across geographies

  • Make the experience good for employees and managers, not just compliant

3. Run the people cycles the company depends on

Performance reviews, compensation and salary increases should run on time, every time, without pulling Claudia into the detail.

  • Own the performance cycle calendar, tooling and manager enablement

  • Run compensation projects and salary review cycles with Claudia and Finance

  • Keep bands, levels and approvals applied consistently

  • Spot what slowed each cycle down and fix it before the next one

4. Turn People data into decisions

Leadership should be able to answer people questions in minutes, with numbers they trust.

  • Build reliable reporting on headcount, attrition, compensation and cycle completion

  • Keep People data clean enough to support planning and board reporting

  • Give Claudia and managers the insight to act early, not after the fact

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

  • 5+ years in People Operations, including time at a startup or scaleup through hypergrowth, with hands-on experience across multiple countries (ideally Belgium and the UK)

  • Hands-on experience scaling a People function: you've seen what breaks between 50 and 200+ people and helped fix it

  • Strong systems thinking: you design processes and tool stacks that hold up as the company grows, not one-off fixes

  • Hands-on experience implementing an HRIS (Deel is a big plus) and running at least one people cycle (performance, comp review or onboarding) end to end.

  • Comfort working with data: you can build a report leadership trusts, and you notice when the numbers look wrong

Mindset

  • High agency, low ego

  • A builder first: you'd rather design the system than run the same manual process twice

  • Pragmatic about risk: you treat compliance as a baseline, not the whole job

  • Ready to step up and own things you've seen done but haven't led yourself

  • Calm and organised when several cycles land at once

Nice to have

  • Real curiosity about AI, ideally with automations or AI tools you've already put to work in People ops

  • Multi-country experience, including the US

  • Payroll experience, especially a payroll provider migration

  • Compensation management experience: bands, reviews and benchmarking

What Success Looks Like

After 6 to 12 months, because you're here:

  • Claudia spends most of her time on People strategy and growing the team, not on daily operations

  • The HRIS is the single source of truth, and nobody keeps a shadow spreadsheet

  • Payroll, EOR and PEO run smoothly across the UK, Belgium and the US, with any payroll migration landed cleanly

  • The last performance and salary review cycles ran on schedule, with clear manager guidance and no last-minute scrambles

  • Every hire, move and exit follows a documented process that works in each country

  • Leadership gets headcount, attrition and comp reporting on demand, from data they trust

  • The People operating system is ready for the next stage of growth, and you're taking on special projects that improve how Conveo works

Why Join Conveo?

At Conveo, you'll join a team that genuinely enjoys working, and spending time, together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That's why we run quarterly team offsites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun.

  • Own a high-impact role at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company

  • Build the People operating system from the ground up, with the room to make it yours

  • Direct access to founders and senior leadership

  • Work with world-class enterprise clients (Unilever, Google, P&G, Orange, and more)

  • Hybrid working model with offices in London, Antwerp, and New York

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside

  • A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition

Compensation: £60K – £80K • Offers Equity

raw.title: Senior Product Engineer (£80k-125k + Equity)
raw.description:
👋 Hey! We're Conveo.ai

Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We started this year as a team of ~20 and are on track to reach ~120 people by year end. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

 

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We’re investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

The engineering team is small and deliberately so. There are no product managers, no designer handoffs, no tickets waiting for someone else to prioritise. Engineers own the full distance from customer problem to working software, and that proximity to the product is exactly what makes this role interesting. You'll report directly to one of our engineering leads, and work incredibly closely with our CTO, Maarten.

Dig deeper into our Engineering/Product ways of working 👉 here 👈


What we're building and why

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

What you'll do

We need a Senior Product Engineer who works backwards from the experience. This is someone who starts with the user's problem, not a spec, and owns everything between that conversation and the code that ships. You shape what gets built, actively contributing to product direction, influencing what we build and how we build it, with real technical and strategic impact.

Own the full stack, from the interface to the infrastructure

Build the interface customers open every day and can't imagine working without. React is the core of what customers see and touch — you lead frontend architecture in React and TypeScript, set the quality bar for components, state management, and performance. And you don't stop there. From API design to cloud infrastructure (AWS), you ship complete, polished features end to end, including AI-powered ones built on LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and async pipelines.

Be the engineering voice in every customer conversation

When a customer has a need, an engineer hears it, interprets it, and solves it. You join customer calls (about once a week), form a clear point of view on what to build, translate feedback into scoped product decisions, and follow through.

Use AI throughout

You reach for agentic solutions first. You use AI to reason, build, review, and test at every stage and you help raise the bar for how the whole team works. Documentation overhead doesn't slow us down here — AI handles that layer, and you're someone who is happy to work that way. You stay current on what frontier models can do and bring that into what we ship.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years of experience building full-stack applications with TypeScript and Node.js.

  • Strong backend experience: designing APIs, working with PostgreSQL, and managing background jobs and async workflows.

  • Solid frontend skills with React. .

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP) — you're comfortable with services like S3, media pipelines, and deployment tooling.

  • Experience building AI-driven applications (e.g. prompt engineering, working with LLM APIs, and/or fine-tuning experience are a plus).

  • Can independently lead projects from concept to launch.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with a keen eye for detail.

  • A collaborative mindset, able to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced team.

Bonus

  • Experience with React Router v7 or Remix.

  • Experience at a small, fast-moving SaaS company where you’ve been client-facing

  • Exposure to market research or qualitative research tooling.

  • You've shipped agentic AI systems to production and can speak to failure modes, evaluations, and tool design.

Why join us?

  • Ship alongside engineers who've built and scaled products used by millions.

  • Work directly with frontier AI models and push what they can actually do.

  • Join a YC-backed team that's growing fast and gives you room to grow with it.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity. We want you to own a real piece of what we're building.

  • Offices in London, Antwerp, and New York. We work best together, so we ask for 3 days a week in the office.

  • Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more.

  • Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to. Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal.

  • Private health coverage with Vitality (incl. dental, vision)

  • Enhanced employer pension contribution (5% employer, 3% employee contribution)

  • Refer someone great and earn up to £5,000.

#LI-ML1

As a Customer Success Partner at CreatorIQ, you will serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of Enterprise customers, helping them achieve meaningful business outcomes through their creator marketing programs. You’ll work closely with customers to understand their goals and align them with CreatorIQ’s platform capabilities, driving long-term adoption, value realization, and program success.

 

You’ll build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders—both virtually and in person—and serve as a proactive partner throughout the customer lifecycle. Customer Success Partners are experts in the CreatorIQ platform, fluent in creator and influencer marketing strategy, and passionate about delivering measurable business impact.

 

You will own the health and retention of your portfolio and will be measured on outcomes including gross retention, platform adoption, customer health, and value realization.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner for a portfolio of customers, aligning CreatorIQ’s capabilities to their business goals and driving measurable value.

  • Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day users to executive stakeholders.

  • Drive platform adoption and customer success by understanding each customer’s strategy, analyzing engagement, and identifying opportunities to increase value.

  • Lead strategic engagements including success planning, business reviews, roadmap discussions, and in-person meetings as appropriate.

  • Own customer health and retention across your portfolio, proactively identifying risk and coordinating action plans to support long-term success.

  • Maintain strategic account plans that capture customer goals, key stakeholders, adoption opportunities, risks, and growth opportunities.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, Services, Support, and Product to deliver a cohesive customer experience and resolve needs effectively.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally while staying current on CreatorIQ capabilities and industry trends to bring relevant insights and best practices to customers.

 

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • Passionate about creator and influencer marketing, social media, and helping customers build successful programs.

  • 3+ years of experience in a strategic customer-facing role, ideally within influencer marketing, an agency, brand, SaaS, or marketing technology environment.

  • Proven ability to manage toward business KPIs, retention goals, customer health, and customer advocacy metrics.

  • Skilled at navigating customer organizations and building relationships across multiple levels, from daily users to executive sponsors.

raw.title: Finance and Strategy Senior Associate
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission.

 

We're looking for a Finance & Strategy Senior Associate to join our London team. In this role, you'll work with partners across Deliveroo to ensure we are making efficient, data-driven decisions that evaluate the effectiveness of our products and unlock new avenues for growth.

 

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Finance & Strategy team. We accelerate the growth of our business by implementing new opportunities and solutions, partnering across the company to improve the profitability and scalability of our business model.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Consumer Product Impact: Evaluate the effectiveness of high-impact consumer products at scale and develop creative growth strategies.

  • Strategic Modelling: Build custom financial models tailored to specific business needs to improve high-stakes strategic decision-making.

  • Framework Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to develop new investment decision-making frameworks and processes in a fast-paced environment.

  • KPI Analysis: Track and analyse key business and financial KPIs, uncovering trends to assess risks and future opportunities.

  • Operational Scaling: Lead special projects to automate and scale reporting tools, investment frameworks, and cost-tracking methodologies.

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strategic Finance Background: Significant experience in strategic finance, corporate finance, or investment banking, ideally within the high-growth technology sector.

  • Advanced Modelling Skills: High proficiency in Excel with a proven ability to build robust financial models and perform complex analyses.

  • Data Fluency: Proficiency in SQL (or a strong willingness to learn) to manipulate large data sets and uncover hidden insights.

  • Commercial Mindset: Strong understanding of budget management and the ability to partner with cross-functional teams to drive operational value.

  • Adaptability: Proven ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, evolving environment that values autonomy and ownership.

 

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

Our Global Structure

Requirements

  • A minimum of 3+ years CRM experience
  • Can work in a fast-paced environment and prioritise workload
  • Attention to detail and campaign deadlines are adhered to, maintaining high standards of accuracy
  • Highly computer literate with:
    • HTML familiarity (ability to understand where changes need to be made)

  • Technical knowledge in CRM automation development
  • Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders groups
  • Data visualisation tools & reporting experience (Looker preferred)

raw.title: Senior Data Science Manager
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.

Our EMEA Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo and Wolt, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation, causal inference and deep business understanding. As part of DoorDash, our EMEA Data Science team brings together colleagues across Deliveroo and Wolt, creating opportunities to learn from different markets and tackle complex local-commerce challenges.

We're looking for a Senior Data Science Manager to shape data science strategy across a broad area of our Logistics organisation. You'll combine strong people leadership, technical judgement and commercial thinking to help our teams make better decisions and deliver measurable business impact.

About The Logistics Team

Logistics makes our marketplace work in the real world: connecting riders with orders and helping deliveries happen efficiently and reliably. The organisation works on problems such as predicting demand, improving delivery-time estimates, and matching orders with riders, all in an efficient way to ensure we can offer the most affordable pricing to our customers.

These are interconnected challenges. Decisions about supply, incentives and network efficiency can affect consumers, riders and restaurant and retail partners at the same time. Data Science helps us understand those relationships, test new approaches and balance delivery reliability, rider experience and sustainable business economics.

It's an environment where rigorous experimentation meets real-world complexity, and where your team's work can shape both everyday operational decisions and longer-term product strategy.

What You'll Be Doing 

You'll own the data science direction and measurable impact of a broad Logistics problem space spanning multiple cross-functional teams. You'll:

  • Set strategy and priorities with Product, Engineering and Operations leaders, focusing investment on the highest-impact opportunities across immediate needs and longer-term goals.
  • Build and develop a high-performing, inclusive team through hiring, coaching and performance management, growing leaders who can deliver independently.
  • Guide solutions to complex marketplace challenges, from balancing supply and demand to evaluating incentives and improving delivery performance and economics.
  • Set the technical bar for experimentation, causal inference and analysis, staying close enough to challenge approaches and ensure decisions reflect real marketplace effects.
  • Influence senior stakeholders and align teams around shared outcomes, resolving competing priorities and turning evidence into product and operational decisions.
  • Directly lead projects that resolve highly complex challenges, which often span across multiple parts of the business and unlock new vectors of impact, boosting company-level goals.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring:

  • A track record of leading and developing high-performing data science or closely related analytical teams, with responsibility for complex work spanning multiple teams or business areas.
  • Experience setting analytical strategy and allocating people and effort across competing priorities, with clear evidence of product, operational or commercial impact.
  • Strong technical foundations in experimentation, causal inference and statistical analysis, with the judgement to select appropriate methods, challenge conclusions and coach experienced practitioners.
  • The ability to reason about interconnected systems and trade-offs, including how an intervention in one part of a marketplace can affect outcomes elsewhere.
  • Experience influencing senior cross-functional leaders, aligning teams around shared goals and turning complex evidence into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • A thoughtful approach to building teams: hiring, coaching, managing performance and developing future technical and people leaders.
  • Comfort creating structure in ambiguous environments, making pragmatic decisions with incomplete information and adapting as new evidence emerges.

Experience developing other people managers would be particularly valuable. Experience in marketplaces, logistics, mobility, pricing, incentives or other operationally complex businesses is helpful, but not essential. We also value leaders who can bring relevant approaches from other domains.

You don't need to have worked on every problem listed here. We're interested in the depth of your leadership, the quality of your judgement and the impact you enable through others.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We're looking for a Senior Manager to join our Finance & Strategy team. In this role, you'll play an integral part in building our business strategy, ensuring we make the most efficient investment and capital allocation decisions to accelerate our global growth.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

You'll be joining the Finance & Strategy team. We partner cross-functionally to improve the profitability, scalability, and defensibility of our business model, carrying projects from initial conception through to final execution.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Strategic Decision Support: Partner with stakeholders across the business to develop new investment decision-making frameworks and drive strategy in a dynamic environment.

  • Growth vs. Profitability: Own complex models and analyses to help the business strike the optimal balance between aggressive growth and long-term profitability.

  • Influencing Power: The ability to earn the trust of senior leaders and influence strategic thinking across a matrixed organisation.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

You Will…

  • Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions
  • Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis
  • Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs
  • Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function

  • Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network

  • A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences

  • A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other

  • Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action

  • A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment
  • Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors
  • Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation

  • A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us build and operate the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.

Get to know our Engineering team, what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions(internally called EventBus) and future streaming platform technologies. These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Design, build and operate large-scale event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.

  • Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, EventBus and related streaming platforms.

  • Debug complex distributed systems issues, including performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production reliability challenges.

  • Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.

  • Contribute to incident response, operational readiness and continuous improvement for Tier-0 infrastructure.

  • Partner closely with EventBus, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams across US and EU regions.

  • Help shape the long-term architecture and evolution of Deliveroo's event streaming platform.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.

  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.

  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable production systems.

  • Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.

  • Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.

  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.

  • Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.

  • Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions(internally called EventBus) and future streaming platform technologies. These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Design, build and operate large-scale event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.

  • Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, EventBus and related streaming platforms.

  • Debug complex distributed systems issues, including performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production reliability challenges.

  • Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.

  • Contribute to incident response, operational readiness and continuous improvement for Tier-0 infrastructure.

  • Partner closely with EventBus, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams across US and EU regions.

  • Help shape the long-term architecture and evolution of Deliveroo's event streaming platform.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.

  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.

  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable production systems.

  • Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.

  • Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.

  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.

  • Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.

  • Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

About the Team

The Core BI team builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our platforms help analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business teams discover trusted data and make informed decisions at scale.

We combine software engineering, platform ownership, and a strong user focus to make BI tooling reliable, secure, scalable and self-service. The team supports the current BI ecosystem while helping shape a more integrated experience across the DoorDash group.

 

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the backend services, APIs and infrastructure our BI platforms run on. This is a hands-on software and platform engineering role: services and integrations, identity and access automation, observability, reliability and developer experience. BI is the domain you serve (primarily Looker and Sigma, and the systems around them), but the problems are backend and platform problems.

You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers and business teams to turn recurring user needs into durable, self-service capabilities. If you're energized by solving technical problems with data and comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!

 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Design, build, test, deploy and operate the backend services, APIs and automation that the BI platforms across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt depend on

  • Automate the platform lifecycle end to end (provisioning, metadata, permissions, migrations, archival and validation) so administration stops being manual work

  • Build the integrations between BI platforms and the wider ecosystem: warehouses, identity providers, orchestration, CI/CD and internal developer tooling

  • Improve the availability, observability, performance, scalability and security of the systems you own, and carry them in production

  • Use AI tooling as part of how you engineer, and where it fits, build LLM-backed capabilities held to the same reliability and governance bar as anything else we ship

  • Raise the engineering bar on the team, from service design and code review to testing, CI/CD and documentation, and improve the developer experience for everyone building on the platform

We're excited about you because…

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend, platform or infrastructure systems

  • Readable, maintainable, well-tested code in Python, plus comfort with SQL and a working understanding of data modelling and warehousing concepts

  • Experience building and owning APIs, integrations or automation in production, with sound judgement on service boundaries, authentication, data contracts and failure modes

  • Hands-on with CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, observability, debugging and incident response, and you expect to operate what you build

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) as part of how you engineer, and judgement about where they help and where they do not

  • End-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems, clear communication with technical and non-technical teams, and comfort self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience owning or integrating with BI platforms such as Looker, Sigma or comparable tools, and familiarity with semantic layers such as LookML or dbt

  • Experience automating identity and access through Okta, SCIM or role-based access controls, or building multi-tenant platforms across brands and regions

  • Experience shipping LLM-backed features to real users (retrieval, grounding and evaluation), or with MCP, agent frameworks or tool-calling in production

raw.description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

You’ll be managing a portfolio of defaulted loan accounts, negotiating repayment arrangements to recover outstanding debt and achieve positive outcomes for Funding Circle’s Investors

  • Manage a portfolio of defaulted loan accounts, negotiating repayment arrangements to recover outstanding debt and achieve positive outcomes for Funding Circle’s investors

  • Build trust and rapport with borrowers and guarantors to understand their financial situations and work with them to find sustainable repayment solutions

  • Demonstrate strong investigatory and analytical skills to achieve maximum but cost-effective recoveries

  • Support with focused campaigns and initiatives to drive performance and investor returns

  • Liaise with instructed third parties and professional advisors, including solicitors, debt managers and insolvency practitioners

  • Work closely with our in-house Collections, Litigation & Business Support Teams in appropriately servicing the interests of Funding Circle’s customers

What we’re looking for 🌱

We value deep expertise, but a growth mindset and good energy are what really make our team click. We’re a group that chooses to lift each other up and think smart every day.

  • Proven experience in Collections, Recoveries, or Credit Control, demonstrating relevant skills and knowledge

  • Results-oriented and competitive: Experience in consistently achieving targets, SLAs, and KPIs while striving for continuous improvement

  • Organised with great attention to detail and the ability to use multiple systems concurrently in the workplace

  • The ability to empathise with borrowers and the commitment to assist them in solving issues through your first-class customer service skills

  • Highly self-motivated and resourceful, with a proven track record of working independently and finding effective solutions to complex problems

  • Able to proactively identify ways to use Generative AI to streamline your daily tasks and improve your personal productivity

  • Confident using approved AI tools safely and effectively to enhance your output and find a better way of working

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!
